23Lfloat pickupNonLinearity (Lfloat x)
24{
25
26 x = x * 2.0f;
27 Lfloat out = (0.075f * x) + (0.00675f * x * x) +( 0.00211f * x * x * x) + (0.000475f * x * x * x * x) + (0.000831f * x * x * x * x *x);
28 out *= 4.366812227074236f;
29 return out;
30}

49Lfloat tPickupNonLinearity_tick (tPickupNonLinearity const p, Lfloat x)
50{
51 x = x * 2.0f;
52 Lfloat out = (0.075f * x) + (0.00675f * x * x) +( 0.00211f * x * x * x) + (0.000475f * x * x * x * x) + (0.000831f * x * x * x * x *x);
53 out *= 4.366812227074236f;
54 Lfloat y = out - p->prev;
55 return y;
56}

64void tPluck_initToPool (tPluck* const pl, Lfloat lowestFrequency, tMempool* const mp)

104Lfloat tPluck_tick (tPluck const p)
105{
106 return (p->lastOut = 3.0f * tAllpassDelay_tick(p->delayLine, tOneZero_tick(p->loopFilter, tAllpassDelay_getLastOut(p->delayLine) * p->loopGain ) ));

109void tPluck_pluck (tPluck const p, Lfloat amplitude)
110{
111 if ( amplitude < 0.0f) amplitude = 0.0f;
112 else if (amplitude > 1.0f) amplitude = 1.0f;
113
114 tOnePole_setPole(p->pickFilter, 0.999f - (amplitude * 0.15f));
115 tOnePole_setGain(p->pickFilter, amplitude * 0.5f );
116
117 // Fill delay with noise additively with current contents.
118 for ( uint32_t i = 0; i < (uint32_t)tAllpassDelay_getDelay(p->delayLine); i++ )
119 tAllpassDelay_tick(p->delayLine, 0.6f * tAllpassDelay_getLastOut(p->delayLine) + tOnePole_tick(p->pickFilter, tNoise_tick(p->noise) ) );
120}

122// Start a note with the given frequency and amplitude.;
123void tPluck_noteOn (tPluck const p, Lfloat frequency, Lfloat amplitude )
124{
125 p->lastFreq = frequency;

127 tPluck_pluck(p, amplitude );
128}

130// Stop a note with the given amplitude (speed of decay).
131void tPluck_noteOff (tPluck const p, Lfloat amplitude )
132{
133 if ( amplitude < 0.0f) amplitude = 0.0f;
134 else if (amplitude > 1.0f) amplitude = 1.0f;
135
136 p->loopGain = 1.0f - amplitude;
137}

139// Set instrument parameters for a particular frequency.
140void tPluck_setFrequency (tPluck const p, Lfloat frequency )
141{
142 if ( frequency <= 0.0f ) frequency = 0.001f;
143
144 // Delay = length - filter delay.
145 Lfloat delay = ( p->sampleRate / frequency ) - tOneZero_getPhaseDelay(p->loopFilter, frequency );
146
147 tAllpassDelay_setDelay(p->delayLine, delay );
148
149 p->loopGain = 0.99f + (frequency * 0.000005f);
150
151 if (p->loopGain >= 0.999f ) p->loopGain = 0.999f;
152}

179void tKarplusStrong_initToPool (tKarplusStrong* const pl, Lfloat lowestFrequency, tMempool* const mp)
180{
181 _tMempool* m = *mp;
182 _tKarplusStrong* p = *pl = (_tKarplusStrong*) mpool_alloc(sizeof(_tKarplusStrong), m);
183 p->mempool = m;
184 LEAF* leaf = p->mempool->leaf;
185
186 p->sampleRate = leaf->sampleRate;
187
188 if ( lowestFrequency <= 0.0f ) lowestFrequency = 8.0f;
189
190 tAllpassDelay_initToPool(&p->delayLine, 0.0f, p->sampleRate * 2, mp);
191 tAllpassDelay_clear(p->delayLine);
192
193 tLinearDelay_initToPool(&p->combDelay, 0.0f, p->sampleRate * 2, mp);
194 tLinearDelay_clear(p->combDelay);
195
196 tOneZero_initToPool(&p->filter, 0.0f, mp);
197
198 tNoise_initToPool(&p->noise, WhiteNoise, mp);
199
200 for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
201 {
202 tBiQuad_initToPool(&p->biquad[i], mp);
203 }
204
205 p->pluckAmplitude = 0.3f;
206 p->pickupPosition = 0.4f;
207
208 p->stretching = 0.9999f;
209 p->baseLoopGain = 0.995f;
210 p->loopGain = 0.999f;
211
212 tKarplusStrong_setFrequency( *pl, 220.0f );
213}

216{

221 tOneZero_free(&p->filter);
222 tNoise_free(&p->noise);
223
224 for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
225 {
226 tBiQuad_free(&p->biquad[i]);
227 }
228
229 mpool_free((char*)p, p->mempool);

232Lfloat tKarplusStrong_getLastOut (tKarplusStrong const p)
233{

235}
236
237Lfloat tKarplusStrong_tick (tKarplusStrong const p)
238{
239 Lfloat temp = tAllpassDelay_getLastOut(p->delayLine) * p->loopGain;
240
241 // Calculate allpass stretching.
242 for (int i=0; i<4; i++) temp = tBiQuad_tick(p->biquad[i],temp);
243
244 // Moving average filter.
245 temp = tOneZero_tick(p->filter, temp);
246
247 Lfloat out = tAllpassDelay_tick(p->delayLine, temp);
248 out = out - tLinearDelay_tick(p->combDelay, out);
249 p->lastOut = out;
250
251 return p->lastOut;
252}
253
254void tKarplusStrong_pluck (tKarplusStrong const p, Lfloat amplitude)
255{
256 if ( amplitude < 0.0f) amplitude = 0.0f;
257 else if (amplitude > 1.0f) amplitude = 1.0f;
258
259 p->pluckAmplitude = amplitude;
260
261 for ( uint32_t i=0; i < (uint32_t)tAllpassDelay_getDelay(p->delayLine); i++ )
262 {
263 // Fill delay with noise additively with current contents.
264 tAllpassDelay_tick(p->delayLine, (tAllpassDelay_getLastOut(p->delayLine) * 0.6f) + 0.4f * tNoise_tick(p->noise) * p->pluckAmplitude );
265 //delayLine_.tick( combDelay_.tick((delayLine_.lastOut() * 0.6) + 0.4 * noise->tick() * pluckAmplitude_) );
266 }
267}

285// Set instrument parameters for a particular frequency.
286void tKarplusStrong_setFrequency (tKarplusStrong const p, Lfloat frequency )
287{
288 if ( frequency <= 0.0f ) frequency = 0.001f;
289
290 p->lastFrequency = frequency;
291 p->lastLength = p->sampleRate / p->lastFrequency;
292 Lfloat delay = p->lastLength - 0.5f;
293 tAllpassDelay_setDelay(p->delayLine, delay);
294
295 // MAYBE MODIFY LOOP GAINS
296 p->loopGain = p->baseLoopGain + (frequency * 0.000005f);
297 if (p->loopGain >= 1.0f) p->loopGain = 0.99999f;
298
299 tKarplusStrong_setStretch(p, p->stretching);
300
301 tLinearDelay_setDelay(p->combDelay, 0.5f * p->pickupPosition * p->lastLength);
302}
303
304// Set the stretch "factor" of the string (0.0 - 1.0).
305void tKarplusStrong_setStretch (tKarplusStrong const p, Lfloat stretch)
306{
307 p->stretching = stretch;
308 Lfloat coefficient;
309 Lfloat freq = p->lastFrequency * 2.0f;
310 Lfloat dFreq = ( (0.5f * p->sampleRate) - freq ) * 0.25f;
311 Lfloat temp = 0.5f + (stretch * 0.5f);
312 if ( temp > 0.9999f ) temp = 0.9999f;
313
314 for ( int i=0; i<4; i++ )
315 {
316 coefficient = temp * temp;
317 tBiQuad_setA2(p->biquad[i], coefficient);
318 tBiQuad_setB0(p->biquad[i], coefficient);
319 tBiQuad_setB2(p->biquad[i], 1.0f);
320
321 coefficient = -2.0f * temp * cosf(TWO_PI * freq / p->sampleRate);
322 tBiQuad_setA1(p->biquad[i], coefficient);
323 tBiQuad_setB1(p->biquad[i], coefficient);
324
325 freq += dFreq;
326 }
327}
328
329// Set the pluck or "excitation" position along the string (0.0 - 1.0).
330void tKarplusStrong_setPickupPosition (tKarplusStrong const p, Lfloat position )
331{
332 if (position < 0.0f) p->pickupPosition = 0.0f;
333 else if (position <= 1.0f) p->pickupPosition = position;
334 else p->pickupPosition = 1.0f;
335
336 tLinearDelay_setDelay(p->combDelay, 0.5f * p->pickupPosition * p->lastLength);
337}
338
339// Set the base loop gain.
340void tKarplusStrong_setBaseLoopGain (tKarplusStrong const p, Lfloat aGain )
341{
342 p->baseLoopGain = aGain;
343 p->loopGain = p->baseLoopGain + (p->lastFrequency * 0.000005f);
344 if ( p->loopGain > 0.99999f ) p->loopGain = 0.99999f;
345}
346
347// Perform the control change specified by \e number and \e value (0.0 - 128.0).
348void tKarplusStrong_controlChange (tKarplusStrong const p, SKControlType type, Lfloat value)
349{
350 if ( value < 0.0f ) value = 0.0f;
351 else if (value > 128.0f) value = 128.0f;
352
353 Lfloat normalizedValue = value * INV_128;
354
355 if (type == SKPickPosition) // 4
356 tKarplusStrong_setPickupPosition(p, normalizedValue );
357 else if (type == SKStringDamping) // 11
358 tKarplusStrong_setBaseLoopGain(p, 0.97f + (normalizedValue * 0.03f) );
359 else if (type == SKDetune) // 1
360 tKarplusStrong_setStretch(p, 0.91f + (0.09f * (1.0f - normalizedValue)) );
361}

381 }
382}

393void tSimpleLivingString_initToPool (tSimpleLivingString* const pl, Lfloat freq, Lfloat dampFreq,
394 Lfloat decay, Lfloat targetLev, Lfloat levSmoothFactor,
395 Lfloat levStrength, int levMode, tMempool* const mp)
396{
397 _tMempool* m = *mp;
398 _tSimpleLivingString* p = *pl = (_tSimpleLivingString*) mpool_alloc(sizeof(_tSimpleLivingString), m);
399 p->mempool = m;
400 LEAF* leaf = p->mempool->leaf;
401
402 p->sampleRate = leaf->sampleRate;
403 p->curr=0.0f;
404 tExpSmooth_initToPool(&p->wlSmooth, p->sampleRate/freq, 0.01f, mp); // smoother for string wavelength (not freq, to avoid expensive divisions)
405 tSimpleLivingString_setFreq(*pl, freq);
406 tLinearDelay_initToPool(&p->delayLine,p->waveLengthInSamples, 2400, mp);
407 tLinearDelay_clear(p->delayLine);
408 tOnePole_initToPool(&p->bridgeFilter, dampFreq, mp);
409 tHighpass_initToPool(&p->DCblocker,13, mp);
410 p->decay=decay;
411 tFeedbackLeveler_initToPool(&p->fbLev, targetLev, levSmoothFactor, levStrength, levMode, mp);
412 p->levMode=levMode;
413}

475Lfloat tSimpleLivingString_tick(tSimpleLivingString const p, Lfloat input)
476{
477 Lfloat stringOut=tOnePole_tick(p->bridgeFilter,tLinearDelay_tickOut(p->delayLine));
478 Lfloat stringInput=tHighpass_tick(p->DCblocker, tFeedbackLeveler_tick(p->fbLev, (p->levMode==0?p->decay*stringOut:stringOut)+input));
479 tLinearDelay_tickIn(p->delayLine, stringInput);
480 tLinearDelay_setDelay(p->delayLine, tExpSmooth_tick(p->wlSmooth));
481 p->curr = stringOut;
482 return p->curr;
483}

595Lfloat tSimpleLivingString2_tick(tSimpleLivingString2 const p, Lfloat input)
596{
597 Lfloat stringOut=tTwoZero_tick(p->bridgeFilter,tHermiteDelay_tickOut(p->delayLine));
598 Lfloat stringInput=tHighpass_tick(p->DCblocker,(tFeedbackLeveler_tick(p->fbLev, (p->levMode==0?p->decay*stringOut:stringOut)+input)));
599 tHermiteDelay_tickIn(p->delayLine, stringInput);
600 tHermiteDelay_setDelay(p->delayLine, tExpSmooth_tick(p->wlSmooth));
601 p->curr = stringOut;
602 return p->curr;
603}

629void tLivingString_initToPool (tLivingString* const pl, Lfloat freq, Lfloat pickPos, Lfloat prepIndex,
630 Lfloat dampFreq, Lfloat decay, Lfloat targetLev, Lfloat levSmoothFactor,
631 Lfloat levStrength, int levMode, tMempool* const mp)
632{
633 _tMempool* m = *mp;
634 _tLivingString* p = *pl = (_tLivingString*) mpool_alloc(sizeof(_tLivingString), m);
635 p->mempool = m;
636 LEAF* leaf = p->mempool->leaf;
637
638 p->sampleRate = leaf->sampleRate;
639 p->curr=0.0f;
640 tExpSmooth_initToPool(&p->wlSmooth, p->sampleRate/freq, 0.01f, mp); // smoother for string wavelength (not freq, to avoid expensive divisions)
641 tLivingString_setFreq(*pl, freq);
642 p->freq = freq;
643 tExpSmooth_initToPool(&p->ppSmooth, pickPos, 0.01f, mp); // smoother for pick position
644 tLivingString_setPickPos(p, pickPos);
645 p->prepIndex=prepIndex;
646 tLinearDelay_initToPool(&p->delLF,p->waveLengthInSamples, 2400, mp);
647 tLinearDelay_initToPool(&p->delUF,p->waveLengthInSamples, 2400, mp);
648 tLinearDelay_initToPool(&p->delUB,p->waveLengthInSamples, 2400, mp);
649 tLinearDelay_initToPool(&p->delLB,p->waveLengthInSamples, 2400, mp);
650 tLinearDelay_clear(p->delLF);
651 tLinearDelay_clear(p->delUF);
652 tLinearDelay_clear(p->delUB);
653 tLinearDelay_clear(p->delLB);
654 p->dampFreq = dampFreq;
655 tOnePole_initToPool(&p->bridgeFilter, dampFreq, mp);
656 tOnePole_initToPool(&p->nutFilter, dampFreq, mp);
657 tOnePole_initToPool(&p->prepFilterU, dampFreq, mp);
658 tOnePole_initToPool(&p->prepFilterL, dampFreq, mp);
659 tHighpass_initToPool(&p->DCblockerU,13, mp);
660 tHighpass_initToPool(&p->DCblockerL,13, mp);
661 p->decay=decay;
662 p->prepIndex = prepIndex;
663 tFeedbackLeveler_initToPool(&p->fbLevU, targetLev, levSmoothFactor, levStrength, levMode, mp);
664 tFeedbackLeveler_initToPool(&p->fbLevL, targetLev, levSmoothFactor, levStrength, levMode, mp);
665 p->levMode=levMode;
666}

678void tSimpleLivingString3_initToPool (tSimpleLivingString3* const pl, int oversampling, Lfloat freq, Lfloat dampFreq,
679 Lfloat decay, Lfloat targetLev, Lfloat levSmoothFactor,
680 Lfloat levStrength, int levMode, tMempool* const mp)
681{
682 _tMempool* m = *mp;
683 _tSimpleLivingString3* p = *pl = (_tSimpleLivingString3*) mpool_alloc(sizeof(_tSimpleLivingString3), m);
684 p->mempool = m;
685 LEAF* leaf = p->mempool->leaf;
686 p->oversampling = oversampling;
687 p->sampleRate = leaf->sampleRate * oversampling;
688 p->curr=0.0f;
689 p->maxLength = 2400 * oversampling;
690 tExpSmooth_initToPool(&p->wlSmooth, p->sampleRate/freq/2.0f, 0.01f, mp); // smoother for string wavelength (not freq, to avoid expensive divisions)
691 tLinearDelay_initToPool(&p->delayLineU,p->waveLengthInSamples, p->maxLength, mp);
692 tLinearDelay_initToPool(&p->delayLineL,p->waveLengthInSamples, p->maxLength, mp);
693 tSimpleLivingString3_setFreq(*pl, freq);
694 tLinearDelay_setDelay(p->delayLineU, p->waveLengthInSamples);
695 tLinearDelay_setDelay(p->delayLineL, p->waveLengthInSamples);
696 //tSimpleLivingString3_setWaveLength(pl, 4800);
697 tLinearDelay_clear(p->delayLineU);
698 tLinearDelay_clear(p->delayLineL);
699 p->dampFreq = dampFreq;
700 tOnePole_initToPool(&p->bridgeFilter, dampFreq, mp);
701 tOnePole_setSampleRate(p->bridgeFilter, p->sampleRate);
702 tOnePole_setFreq(p->bridgeFilter, dampFreq);
703 p->rippleGain = 0.0f;
704 p->rippleDelay = 0.5f;
705 p->invOnePlusr = 1.0f;
706 tHighpass_initToPool(&p->DCblocker,13, mp);
707 tHighpass_setSampleRate(p->DCblocker,p->sampleRate);
708 tHighpass_setFreq(p->DCblocker,13);
709 p->userDecay = decay;
710
711 tFeedbackLeveler_initToPool(&p->fbLev, targetLev, levSmoothFactor, levStrength, levMode, mp);
712 p->levMode=levMode;
713 p->changeGainCompensator = 1.0f;
714
715 p->freq = freq;
716 Lfloat waveLength = (p->sampleRate/freq);
717 if (waveLength<4.8) waveLength=4.8f;
718 else if (waveLength>p->maxLength*2) waveLength=p->maxLength*2;
719 p->waveLengthInSamples = waveLength * 0.5f;
720 tExpSmooth_setDest(p->wlSmooth, p->waveLengthInSamples);
721
722 Lfloat temp = ((p->userDecay * 0.01f) + 0.01f) * 6.9078f;
723 p->decay = exp(-6.91 * ((1.0 / p->freq) / temp));
724 p->pickupPoint = 0.9f;
725 //p->decay=powf(0.001f,1.0f/(p->freq*p->userDecay));
726 p->prevDelayLength = p->waveLengthInSamples;
727
728
729}

813void tSimpleLivingString3_pluck(tSimpleLivingString3 const p, Lfloat input, Lfloat position)
814{
815 int length = p->waveLengthInSamples;
816 int pluckPoint = (int)(length * position);
817 if (pluckPoint < 1)
818 {
819 pluckPoint = 1;
820 }
821 else if (pluckPoint > (length-1))
822 {
823 pluckPoint = length-1;
824 }
825 int remainder = length-pluckPoint;
826 for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
827 {
828 Lfloat val = 0.0f;
829 if (i <= pluckPoint)
830 {
831 val = input * ((Lfloat)i/(Lfloat)pluckPoint);
832 }
833 else
834 {
835 val = input * (1.0f - (((Lfloat)i-(Lfloat)pluckPoint)/(Lfloat)remainder));
836
837 }
838 int bufWritePoint = (i+p->delayLineU->outPoint)%p->delayLineU->maxDelay;
839 p->delayLineU->buff[bufWritePoint] = val;
840 }
841 for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
842 {
843 int currentBufWritePoint = (i+p->delayLineL->outPoint) % p->delayLineL->maxDelay;
844 int currentBufReadPoint = ((length-1-i)+p->delayLineU->outPoint);
845 int currentBufReadPointMod = currentBufReadPoint % p->delayLineU->maxDelay;
846 p->delayLineL->buff[currentBufWritePoint] = p->delayLineU->buff[currentBufReadPointMod];
847 }
848}
849
850Lfloat tSimpleLivingString3_tick(tSimpleLivingString3 const p, Lfloat input)
851{
852 //p->changeGainCompensator = 1.0f;
853 Lfloat wl = tExpSmooth_tick(p->wlSmooth);
854 //Lfloat changeInDelayTime = wl - p->prevDelayLength;
855 //if (changeInDelayTime < 0.0f)
856 {
857 // p->changeGainCompensator = sqrtf(1.0f - changeInDelayTime);
858 }
859 tLinearDelay_setDelay(p->delayLineU, wl);
860 tLinearDelay_setDelay(p->delayLineL, wl);
861
862 for (int i = 0; i < p->oversampling; i++)
863 {
864 p->Uout = tHighpass_tick(p->DCblocker,tOnePole_tick(p->bridgeFilter,tLinearDelay_tickOut(p->delayLineU))* (p->decay * p->invOnePlusr));
865 p->Uout = LEAF_clip(-1.0f, tFeedbackLeveler_tick(p->fbLev, p->Uout), 1.0f);
866 //p->Uout = tLinearDelay_tickOut(&p->delayLineU) * p->decay;
867 p->Lout = LEAF_clip(-1.0f, tLinearDelay_tickOut(p->delayLineL), 1.0f);
868
869 tLinearDelay_tickIn(p->delayLineU, (-1.0f * p->Lout) + input);
870 tLinearDelay_tickIn(p->delayLineL, -1.0f * p->Uout);
871 tLinearDelay_addTo (p->delayLineU, p->Lout * p->rippleGain, p->rippleDelay*wl);
872 }
873
874 //calculate pickup point
875 Lfloat point = wl * p->pickupPoint;
876 Lfloat reversePoint = wl * (1.0f - p->pickupPoint);
877 int32_t whichPoint = ((int32_t)roundf(point));
878 Lfloat LfloatPart = point - whichPoint;
879
880 int32_t outpointplus =((int32_t)p->delayLineU->outPoint + whichPoint);
881 int32_t outpointmod = outpointplus % (int32_t)p->delayLineU->maxDelay;
882 int32_t outpointmod2 = (outpointmod + 1) % (int32_t)p->delayLineU->maxDelay;
883 Lfloat sampleBitOne = (p->delayLineU->buff[outpointmod] * (1.0f - LfloatPart)) + (p->delayLineU->buff[outpointmod2] * LfloatPart);
884
885
886 whichPoint = (int32_t)roundf(reversePoint);
887 LfloatPart = reversePoint - whichPoint;
888 outpointplus =(((int32_t)p->delayLineL->outPoint) + whichPoint);
889 outpointmod = outpointplus % (int32_t)p->delayLineL->maxDelay;
890 outpointmod2 = (outpointmod + 1) % (int32_t)p->delayLineL->maxDelay;
891 Lfloat sampleBitTwo = (p->delayLineL->buff[outpointmod] * (1.0f - LfloatPart)) + (p->delayLineL->buff[outpointmod2] * LfloatPart);
892
893 p->curr = 0.5f * (sampleBitOne + sampleBitTwo);
894 //p->curr = p->Uout;
895
896 p->prevDelayLength = p->waveLengthInSamples;
897 //Lfloat stringInput=tHighpass_tick(&p->DCblocker, tFeedbackLeveler_tick(&p->fbLev, (p->levMode==0?p->decay*stringOut:stringOut)+input));
898 //tLinearDelay_tickIn(&p->delayLine, stringInput);
899 //tLinearDelay_setDelay(&p->delayLine, tExpSmooth_tick(&p->wlSmooth));
900 //p->curr = d1 + d2;
901 return p->curr;
902}

1080void tSimpleLivingString4_pluck(tSimpleLivingString4 const p, Lfloat input, Lfloat position)
1081{
1082 int length = p->waveLengthInSamples;
1083 p->pluckPosition = position;
1084 int pluckPoint = (int)(length * position);
1085 if (pluckPoint < 1)
1086 {
1087 pluckPoint = 1;
1088 }
1089 else if (pluckPoint > (length-1))
1090 {
1091 pluckPoint = length-1;
1092 }
1093 int remainder = length-pluckPoint;
1094 for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
1095 {
1096 Lfloat val = 0.0f;
1097 if (i <= pluckPoint)
1098 {
1099 val = input * LEAF_tanh(((Lfloat)i/(Lfloat)pluckPoint)*1.2f);
1100 }
1101 else
1102 {
1103 val = input * LEAF_tanh((1.0f - (((Lfloat)i-(Lfloat)pluckPoint)/(Lfloat)remainder))*1.2f);
1104
1105 }
1106 int bufWritePoint = (i+p->delayLineU->outPoint)%p->delayLineU->maxDelay;
1107 p->delayLineU->buff[bufWritePoint] = val;
1108 }
1109 for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
1110 {
1111 int otherBufPosition = ((length-1-i) + p->delayLineU->outPoint)%p->delayLineU->maxDelay;
1112 int bufWritePoint = (i+p->delayLineL->outPoint)%p->delayLineL->maxDelay;
1113 p->delayLineL->buff[bufWritePoint] = p->delayLineU->buff[otherBufPosition];
1114 }
1115}
1116
1117void tSimpleLivingString4_pluckNoPosition(tSimpleLivingString4 const p, Lfloat input)
1118{
1119 int length = p->waveLengthInSamples;
1120 Lfloat position = p->pluckPosition;
1121 int pluckPoint = (int)(length * position);
1122 if (pluckPoint < 1)
1123 {
1124 pluckPoint = 1;
1125 }
1126 else if (pluckPoint > (length-1))
1127 {
1128 pluckPoint = length-1;
1129 }
1130 int remainder = length-pluckPoint;
1131 for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
1132 {
1133 Lfloat val = 0.0f;
1134 if (i <= pluckPoint)
1135 {
1136 val = input * LEAF_tanh(((Lfloat)i/(Lfloat)pluckPoint)*1.2f);
1137 }
1138 else
1139 {
1140 val = input * LEAF_tanh((1.0f - (((Lfloat)i-(Lfloat)pluckPoint)/(Lfloat)remainder))*1.2f);
1141
1142 }
1143 int bufWritePoint = (i+p->delayLineU->outPoint)%p->delayLineU->maxDelay;
1144 p->delayLineU->buff[bufWritePoint] = val;
1145 }
1146 for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
1147 {
1148 int otherBufPosition = ((length-1-i) + p->delayLineU->outPoint)%p->delayLineU->maxDelay;
1149 int bufWritePoint = (i+p->delayLineL->outPoint)%p->delayLineL->maxDelay;
1150 p->delayLineL->buff[bufWritePoint] = p->delayLineU->buff[otherBufPosition];
1151 }
1152}

1155
1156Lfloat tSimpleLivingString4_tick(tSimpleLivingString4 const p, Lfloat input)
1157{
1158 p->changeGainCompensator = 1.0f;
1159 Lfloat wl = tExpSmooth_tick(p->wlSmooth);
1160 volatile Lfloat changeInDelayTime = -0.01875f*(wl*0.5f - p->prevDelayLength*0.5f);
1161 if (changeInDelayTime < -0.1f)
1162 {
1163 p->changeGainCompensator = sqrtf(1.0f - changeInDelayTime);
1164 }
1165 else{
1166 p->changeGainCompensator = 1.0f;
1167 }
1168 tLinearDelay_setDelay(p->delayLineU, wl);
1169 tLinearDelay_setDelay(p->delayLineL, wl);
1170
1171 for (int i = 0; i < p->oversampling; i++)
1172 {
1173 p->Uout = tHighpass_tick(p->DCblocker,tOnePole_tick(p->bridgeFilter,tLinearDelay_tickOut(p->delayLineU))* (p->decay - fabsf(p->rippleGain)));
1174 p->Uout = LEAF_clip(-1.0f, tFeedbackLeveler_tick(p->fbLev, p->Uout), 1.0f);
1175 //p->Uout = tLinearDelay_tickOut(&p->delayLineU) * p->decay;
1176 p->Lout = LEAF_clip(-1.0f, tLinearDelay_tickOut(p->delayLineL), 1.0f);
1177
1178 tLinearDelay_tickIn(p->delayLineU, (-1.0f * p->Lout)* p->changeGainCompensator);
1179 tLinearDelay_tickIn(p->delayLineL, (-1.0f * p->Uout));
1180 tLinearDelay_addTo (p->delayLineU, input, p->pluckPosition*wl);
1181 tLinearDelay_addTo (p->delayLineL, input, (1.0f - p->pluckPosition)*wl);
1182 tLinearDelay_addTo (p->delayLineU, p->Lout * p->rippleGain, p->rippleDelay*wl);
1183 }
1184
1185 //calculate pickup point
1186 volatile Lfloat point = LEAF_clip(2.0f, wl * p->pickupPoint, wl-2.0f);
1187 volatile Lfloat reversePoint = LEAF_clip(2.0f, wl * (1.0f - p->pickupPoint),wl-2.0f);
1188 volatile int32_t whichPoint = ((int32_t)(point+0.5f));
1189 volatile Lfloat LfloatPart = point - whichPoint;
1190
1191 volatile int32_t outpointplus =((int32_t)p->delayLineU->outPoint + whichPoint);
1192 volatile int32_t outpointmod = outpointplus % (int32_t)p->delayLineU->maxDelay;
1193 volatile int32_t outpointmod2 = (outpointmod + 1) % (int32_t)p->delayLineU->maxDelay;
1194 volatile Lfloat sampleBitOne = (p->delayLineU->buff[outpointmod] * (1.0f - LfloatPart)) + (p->delayLineU->buff[outpointmod2] * LfloatPart);
1195
1196
1197 whichPoint = (int32_t)(reversePoint+0.5f);
1198 LfloatPart = reversePoint - whichPoint;
1199 outpointplus =(((int32_t)p->delayLineL->outPoint) + whichPoint);
1200 outpointmod = outpointplus % (int32_t)p->delayLineL->maxDelay;
1201 outpointmod2 = (outpointmod + 1) % (int32_t)p->delayLineL->maxDelay;
1202 Lfloat sampleBitTwo = (p->delayLineL->buff[outpointmod] * (1.0f - LfloatPart)) + (p->delayLineL->buff[outpointmod2] * LfloatPart);
1203
1204 p->curr = 0.5f * (sampleBitOne + sampleBitTwo) * p->changeGainCompensator;
1205 //p->curr = p->Uout;
1206
1207 p->prevDelayLength = p->waveLengthInSamples;
1208 //Lfloat stringInput=tHighpass_tick(&p->DCblocker, tFeedbackLeveler_tick(&p->fbLev, (p->levMode==0?p->decay*stringOut:stringOut)+input));
1209 //tLinearDelay_tickIn(&p->delayLine, stringInput);
1210 //tLinearDelay_setDelay(&p->delayLine, tExpSmooth_tick(&p->wlSmooth));
1211 //p->curr = d1 + d2;
1212 return p->curr;
1213}

1250void tSimpleLivingString5_initToPool (tSimpleLivingString5* const pl, int oversampling, Lfloat freq, Lfloat dampFreq,
1251 Lfloat decay, Lfloat prepPos, Lfloat prepIndex, Lfloat pluckPos, Lfloat targetLev, Lfloat levSmoothFactor,
1252 Lfloat levStrength, int levMode, tMempool* const mp)
1253{
1254 _tMempool* m = *mp;
1255 _tSimpleLivingString5* p = *pl = (_tSimpleLivingString5*) mpool_alloc(sizeof(_tSimpleLivingString5), m);
1256 p->mempool = m;
1257 LEAF* leaf = p->mempool->leaf;
1258 p->oversampling = oversampling;
1259 p->sampleRate = leaf->sampleRate * oversampling;
1260 p->curr=0.0f;
1261 p->maxLength = 2400 * oversampling;
1262 p->prepPos = prepPos;
1263 p->prepIndex = prepIndex;
1264 p->pluckPosition = pluckPos;
1265 tExpSmooth_initToPool(&p->prepPosSmooth, prepPos, 0.001f , mp);
1266 tExpSmooth_initToPool(&p->prepIndexSmooth, prepIndex, 0.001f , mp);
1267
1268 tExpSmooth_initToPool(&p->wlSmooth, p->sampleRate/freq/2.0f, 0.05f , mp); // smoother for string wavelength (not freq, to avoid expensive divisions)
1269
1270 tExpSmooth_initToPool(&p->pluckPosSmooth, pluckPos, 0.001f , mp);
1271 tExpSmooth_initToPool(&p->pickupPointSmooth, pluckPos, 0.001f , mp);
1272
1273 tLagrangeDelay_initToPool(&p->delUF,p->waveLengthInSamples, p->maxLength, mp);
1274 tLagrangeDelay_initToPool(&p->delUB,p->waveLengthInSamples, p->maxLength, mp);
1275 tLagrangeDelay_initToPool(&p->delLF,p->waveLengthInSamples, p->maxLength, mp);
1276 tLagrangeDelay_initToPool(&p->delLB,p->waveLengthInSamples, p->maxLength, mp);
1277 tSimpleLivingString5_setFreq(p, freq);
1278 tLagrangeDelay_setDelay(p->delUF, p->waveLengthInSamples-(p->prepPos*p->waveLengthInSamples));
1279 tLagrangeDelay_setDelay(p->delUB, p->waveLengthInSamples-((1.0f-p->prepPos)*p->waveLengthInSamples));
1280 tLagrangeDelay_setDelay(p->delLF, p->waveLengthInSamples-(p->prepPos*p->waveLengthInSamples));
1281 tLagrangeDelay_setDelay(p->delLB, p->waveLengthInSamples-((1.0f-p->prepPos)*p->waveLengthInSamples));
1282 //tSimpleLivingString5_setWaveLength(pl, 4800);
1283 tLagrangeDelay_clear(p->delUF);
1284 tLagrangeDelay_clear(p->delUB);
1285 tLagrangeDelay_clear(p->delLF);
1286 tLagrangeDelay_clear(p->delLB);
1287 p->dampFreq = dampFreq;
1288 tOnePole_initToPool(&p->bridgeFilter, dampFreq, mp);
1289 tOnePole_setSampleRate(p->bridgeFilter, p->sampleRate);
1290 tOnePole_setFreq(p->bridgeFilter, dampFreq);
1291
1292 tOnePole_initToPool(&p->nutFilter, dampFreq, mp);
1293 tOnePole_setSampleRate(p->nutFilter, p->sampleRate);
1294 tOnePole_setFreq(p->nutFilter, dampFreq);
1295
1296
1297
1298
1299 p->rippleGain = 0.0f;
1300 p->rippleDelay = 0.5f;
1301
1302
1303 tHighpass_initToPool(&p->DCblocker,0.001f, mp);
1304 tHighpass_setSampleRate(p->DCblocker,p->sampleRate);
1305 tHighpass_setFreq(p->DCblocker,0.001f);
1306
1307 tHighpass_initToPool(&p->DCblocker2,0.001f, mp);
1308 tHighpass_setSampleRate(p->DCblocker2,p->sampleRate);
1309 tHighpass_setFreq(p->DCblocker2,0.001f);
1310
1311 p->userDecay = decay;
1312 p->pluckPosition = 0.8f;
1313 tFeedbackLeveler_initToPool(&p->fbLev, targetLev, levSmoothFactor, levStrength, levMode, mp);
1314 p->levMode=levMode;
1315 p->changeGainCompensator = 1.0f;
1316
1317 tFeedbackLeveler_initToPool(&p->fbLev2, targetLev, levSmoothFactor, levStrength, levMode, mp);
1318
1319 p->ff = 0.3f;
1320 p->freq = freq;
1321 Lfloat waveLength = (p->sampleRate/freq);
1322 if (waveLength<4.8) waveLength=4.8f;
1323 else if (waveLength>p->maxLength*2) waveLength=p->maxLength*2;
1324 p->waveLengthInSamples = waveLength * 0.5f;
1325 tExpSmooth_setDest(p->wlSmooth, p->waveLengthInSamples);
1326
1327 //Lfloat temp = ((p->userDecay * 0.01f) + 0.01f) * 6.9078f;
1328 //p->decay = exp(-6.91 * ((1.0 / p->freq) / temp));
1329 p->decay = decay;
1330 p->pickupPoint = 0.9f;
1331 //p->decay=powf(0.001f,1.0f/(p->freq*p->userDecay));
1332 p->prevDelayLength = p->waveLengthInSamples;
1333
1334
1335}

1454void tSimpleLivingString5_pluck(tSimpleLivingString5 const p, Lfloat input, Lfloat position)
1455{
1456 //p->pluckPosition = position;
1457 p->pluckPosition = 0.5f;
1458 tExpSmooth_setDest(p->pluckPosSmooth, position);
1459 volatile Lfloat pluckPoint = position*p->waveLengthInSamples;
1460 pluckPoint = LEAF_clip(1.0f, pluckPoint, p->waveLengthInSamples-1.0f);
1461 uint32_t pluckPointInt = (uint32_t) pluckPoint;
1462 volatile Lfloat remainder = p->waveLengthInSamples-pluckPoint;
1463 Lfloat BLen = p->delUB->delay;
1464 Lfloat FLen = p->delUF->delay;
1465 uint32_t FLenInt = (uint32_t)FLen;
1466 //float FLenAlpha = FLen -FLenInt;
1467 uint32_t BLenInt = (uint32_t)BLen;
1468 Lfloat BLenAlpha = BLen -BLenInt;
1469
1470 for (uint32_t i = 0; i < p->waveLengthInSamples; i++)
1471 {
1472 Lfloat val = 0.0f;
1473 if (i <= pluckPointInt)
1474 {
1475 val = input * ((Lfloat)i/(Lfloat)pluckPointInt);
1476 }
1477 else
1478 {
1479 val = input * (1.0f - (((Lfloat)i-(Lfloat)pluckPointInt)/(Lfloat)remainder));
1480 }
1481 if (i < BLenInt)
1482 {
1483 tLagrangeDelay_addTo(p->delUB, val, i);
1484 tLagrangeDelay_addTo(p->delLB, val, BLenInt-i);
1485 }
1486 else if (i == BLenInt)
1487 {
1488 tLagrangeDelay_addTo(p->delUB, val * (1.0f-BLenAlpha), i);
1489 tLagrangeDelay_addTo(p->delLB, val * (1.0f-BLenAlpha), BLenInt-i);
1490 tLagrangeDelay_addTo(p->delUF, val * BLenAlpha, i-BLenInt);
1491 tLagrangeDelay_addTo(p->delLF, val * BLenAlpha, (FLenInt-1)-(i-BLenInt));
1492 }
1493 else
1494 {
1495 tLagrangeDelay_addTo(p->delUF, val, i-BLenInt);
1496 tLagrangeDelay_addTo(p->delLF, val, (FLenInt-1)-(i-BLenInt));
1497 }
1498 }
1499}

1505Lfloat tSimpleLivingString5_tick(tSimpleLivingString5 const p, Lfloat input)
1506{
1507 //p->changeGainCompensator = 1.0f;
1508 Lfloat wl = tExpSmooth_tick(p->wlSmooth);
1509
1510 //volatile Lfloat changeInDelayTime = -0.01875f*(wl*0.5f - p->prevDelayLength*0.5f);
1511 //if (changeInDelayTime < -0.1f)
1512 {
1513 // p->changeGainCompensator = sqrtf(1.0f - changeInDelayTime);
1514 }
1515 //else
1516 {
1517 // p->changeGainCompensator = 1.0f;
1518 }
1519 Lfloat prepPosSmoothed = tExpSmooth_tick(p->prepPosSmooth);
1520 Lfloat FLen = wl*(1.0f-prepPosSmoothed);
1521 uint32_t FLenInt = (uint32_t)FLen;
1522 Lfloat BLen = wl*prepPosSmoothed;
1523 uint32_t BLenInt = (uint32_t)BLen;
1524 tLagrangeDelay_setDelay(p->delUF, FLen);
1525 tLagrangeDelay_setDelay(p->delUB, BLen);
1526 tLagrangeDelay_setDelay(p->delLF, FLen);
1527 tLagrangeDelay_setDelay(p->delLB, BLen);
1528 Lfloat pluckPosSmoothed = tExpSmooth_tick(p->pluckPosSmooth);
1529 Lfloat pluckPosInSamples = pluckPosSmoothed * wl;
1530 uint32_t pluckPosInSamplesInt = (uint32_t) pluckPosInSamples;
1531 Lfloat alpha = pluckPosInSamples - pluckPosInSamplesInt;
1532
1533 uint32_t sample1 = pluckPosInSamplesInt;
1534 uint32_t sample2 = pluckPosInSamplesInt + 1;
1535
1536 uint32_t sample1Front = (uint32_t) (sample1 - BLen);
1537 uint32_t sample2Front = (uint32_t) (sample2 - BLen);
1538
1539
1540
1541
1542 //now tick out the output data and filter (oversampled)
1543 for (int i = 0; i < p->oversampling; i++)
1544 {
1545 if (sample1 < BLenInt)
1546 {
1547 tLagrangeDelay_addTo(p->delUB, input * (1.0f - alpha), sample1);
1548 tLagrangeDelay_addTo(p->delLB, input * (1.0f - alpha), BLenInt-sample1);
1549 }
1550 else
1551 {
1552 tLagrangeDelay_addTo(p->delUF, input * (1.0f - alpha), sample1Front);
1553 tLagrangeDelay_addTo(p->delLF, input * (1.0f - alpha), FLenInt-sample1Front);
1554 }
1555 if (sample2 < BLenInt)
1556 {
1557 tLagrangeDelay_addTo(p->delUB, input * alpha, sample2);
1558 tLagrangeDelay_addTo(p->delLB, input * alpha, BLenInt-sample2);
1559 }
1560 else
1561 {
1562 tLagrangeDelay_addTo(p->delUF, input * alpha, sample2Front);
1563 tLagrangeDelay_addTo(p->delLF, input * alpha, FLenInt-sample2Front);
1564 }
1565
1566
1567 Lfloat fromUF=tLagrangeDelay_tickOut(p->delUF);
1568 Lfloat fromLF=tLagrangeDelay_tickOut(p->delLF);
1569 Lfloat fromLB=tLagrangeDelay_tickOut(p->delLB);
1570 Lfloat fromUB=tLagrangeDelay_tickOut(p->delUB);
1571 //fromUF = tanhf(p->fbSample1) * p->fb + fromUF*0.1f;
1572 //fromLB = tanhf(p->fbSample2) * p->fb + fromLB*0.1f;
1573 //p->fbSample1 = fromUF;
1574 //p->fbSample2 = fromLB;
1575 //fromUF = fromUF * 1.0f / (1.0f+p->fb);
1576 //fromLB = fromLB * 1.0f / (1.0f+p->fb);
1577 //fromUF = tWavefolder_tick(&p->wf1, fromUF);
1578 //fromLB = tWavefolder_tick(&p->wf2, fromLB);
1579 //softclip approx for tanh saturation in original code
1580 //float fromUFSat = tanhf(fromUF + input);
1581 float fromUFSat = tanhf(fromUF);
1582 float fromLBSat = tanhf(fromLB);
1583
1584 fromUF = (p->ff * fromUFSat) + ((1.0f - p->ff) * fromUF);
1585 fromLB = (p->ff * fromLBSat) + ((1.0f - p->ff) * fromLB);
1586
1587#if 0
1588 Lfloat fromBridge = -tOnePole_tick(&p->bridgeFilter, fromUF);
1589 tLagrangeDelay_tickIn(&p->delLF, fromBridge + input);
1590 tLagrangeDelay_tickIn(&p->delLB, fromLF);
1591 Lfloat fromNut=-fromLB;
1592 tLagrangeDelay_tickIn(&p->delUB, fromNut);
1593 tLagrangeDelay_tickIn(&p->delUF, fromUB);
1594#endif
1595
1596 // into front half of string, from bridge, going backwards (lower section)
1597 //Lfloat fromBridge=-tFeedbackLeveler_tick(&p->fbLev, (p->levMode==0?p->decay:1.0f)*tHighpass_tick(&p->DCblocker, tOnePole_tick(&p->bridgeFilter, fromUF)));
1598 //Lfloat fromBridge=-tFeedbackLeveler_tick(&p->fbLev, (p->levMode==0?p->decay:1.0f)*fromUF);
1599 Lfloat fromBridge=-p->decay*fromUF;//tOnePole_tick(&p->bridgeFilter, fromUF);
1600 //Lfloat fromBridge=-tHighpass_tick(&p->DCblocker, tOnePole_tick(&p->bridgeFilter, fromUF)) * p->decay; //version with feedbackleveler
1601 //fromBridge = LEAF_clip(-1.0f, fromBridge, 1.0f);
1602 tLagrangeDelay_tickIn(p->delLF, fromBridge);
1603 // into back half of string, from prepPoint, going backwards (lower section)
1604 //Lfloat fromUpperPrep=-tOnePole_tick(&p->prepFilterL, fromUB);
1605 Lfloat fromUpperPrep=-fromUB;
1606 //fromUpperPrep = LEAF_clip(-1.0f, fromUpperPrep, 1.0f);
1607 Lfloat intoLower=p->prepIndex*fromUpperPrep+(1.0f - p->prepIndex)*fromLF; //used to add input here
1608 //intoLower = LEAF_clip(-1.0f, intoLower, 1.0f);
1609 tLagrangeDelay_tickIn(p->delLB, intoLower);
1610 // into back of string, from nut going forward (upper section)
1611 //Lfloat fromNut=-tFeedbackLeveler_tick(&p->fbLev2, (p->levMode==0?p->decay:1.0f)*tHighpass_tick(&p->DCblocker2,fromLB));
1612 //Lfloat fromNut=-tFeedbackLeveler_tick(&p->fbLev2, (p->levMode==0?p->decay:1.0f)*fromLB);
1613 Lfloat fromNut=-p->decay*fromLB;//tOnePole_tick(&p->nutFilter, fromLB);
1614 //Lfloat fromNut=-p->decay*tHighpass_tick(&p->DCblocker2,fromLB)); //version without feedback leveler
1615 //fromNut = LEAF_clip(-1.0f, fromNut, 1.0f);
1616 tLagrangeDelay_tickIn(p->delUB, fromNut);
1617 // into front half of string, from prepPoint, going forward (upper section)
1618 //Lfloat fromLowerPrep=-tOnePole_tick(&p->prepFilterU, fromLF);
1619 Lfloat fromLowerPrep=-fromLF;
1620 //fromLowerPrep = LEAF_clip(-1.0f, fromLowerPrep, 1.0f);
1621 Lfloat intoUpperFront=p->prepIndex*fromLowerPrep+(1.0f - p->prepIndex)*fromUB;
1622 //intoUpper = tanhf(intoUpper);
1623 //intoUpperFront = LEAF_clip(-1.0f, intoUpperFront, 1.0f);
1624 tLagrangeDelay_tickIn(p->delUF, intoUpperFront);
1625
1626 p->curr = fromBridge;
1627 }
1628
1629 //pick up the signal
1630 Lfloat pickupPointSmoothed = tExpSmooth_tick(p->pickupPointSmooth);
1631 Lfloat pickupPosInSamples = pickupPointSmoothed * wl;
1632
1633
1634 Lfloat sample1Front2 = (pickupPosInSamples - BLen);
1635
1636 uint32_t a1 = (uint32_t) pickupPosInSamples;
1637 Lfloat a1F =pickupPosInSamples - (Lfloat) a1;
1638
1639 uint32_t a2 = (uint32_t) (BLen-pickupPosInSamples);
1640 Lfloat a2F =(BLen-pickupPosInSamples) - (Lfloat) a2;
1641
1642 uint32_t a3 = (uint32_t) sample1Front2;
1643 Lfloat a3F =sample1Front2 - (Lfloat) a3;
1644
1645 uint32_t a4 = (uint32_t) (FLen-sample1Front2);
1646 Lfloat a4F = (FLen-sample1Front2) - (Lfloat) a4;
1647
1648 Lfloat outputSample1 = 0.0f;
1649
1650 if (pickupPosInSamples < BLen)
1651 {
1652 outputSample1 = tLagrangeDelay_tapOutInterpolated(p->delUB, a1, a1F);
1653 outputSample1 += tLagrangeDelay_tapOutInterpolated(p->delLB, a2, a2F);
1654 }
1655 else
1656 {
1657 outputSample1 = tLagrangeDelay_tapOutInterpolated(p->delUF, a3, a3F);
1658 outputSample1 += tLagrangeDelay_tapOutInterpolated(p->delLF, a4, a4F);
1659 }
1660
1661 p->curr = 0.5f * outputSample1;
1662 //p->curr = p->Uout;
1663 p->prevDelayLength = p->waveLengthInSamples;
1664
1665 //Lfloat stringInput=tHighpass_tick(&p->DCblocker, tFeedbackLeveler_tick(&p->fbLev, (p->levMode==0?p->decay*stringOut:stringOut)+input));
1666 //tLinearDelay_tickIn(&p->delayLine, stringInput);
1667 //tLinearDelay_setDelay(&p->delayLine, tExpSmooth_tick(&p->wlSmooth));
1668 //p->curr = d1 + d2;
1669 return p->curr;
1670}

1794Lfloat tLivingString_tick(tLivingString const p, Lfloat input)
1795{
1796 // from pickPos upwards=forwards
1797 Lfloat fromLF=tLinearDelay_tickOut(p->delLF);
1798 Lfloat fromUF=tLinearDelay_tickOut(p->delUF);
1799 Lfloat fromUB=tLinearDelay_tickOut(p->delUB);
1800 Lfloat fromLB=tLinearDelay_tickOut(p->delLB);
1801 // into upper half of string, from nut, going backwards
1802 Lfloat fromNut=-tFeedbackLeveler_tick(p->fbLevU, (p->levMode==0?p->decay:1)*tHighpass_tick(p->DCblockerU, tOnePole_tick(p->nutFilter, fromUF)));
1803 tLinearDelay_tickIn(p->delUB, fromNut);
1804 // into lower half of string, from pickpoint, going backwards
1805 Lfloat fromLowerPrep=-tOnePole_tick(p->prepFilterL, fromLF);
1806 Lfloat intoLower=p->prepIndex*fromLowerPrep+(1.0f - p->prepIndex)*fromUB+input;
1807 tLinearDelay_tickIn(p->delLB, intoLower);
1808 // into lower half of string, from bridge
1809 Lfloat fromBridge=-tFeedbackLeveler_tick(p->fbLevL, (p->levMode==0?p->decay:1.0f)*tHighpass_tick(p->DCblockerL, tOnePole_tick(p->bridgeFilter, fromLB)));
1810 tLinearDelay_tickIn(p->delLF, fromBridge);
1811 // into upper half of string, from pickpoint, going forwards/upwards
1812 Lfloat fromUpperPrep=-tOnePole_tick(p->prepFilterU, fromUB);
1813 Lfloat intoUpper=p->prepIndex*fromUpperPrep+(1.0f - p->prepIndex)*fromLF+input;
1814 tLinearDelay_tickIn(p->delUF, intoUpper);
1815 // update all delay lengths
1816 Lfloat pickP=tExpSmooth_tick(p->ppSmooth);
1817 Lfloat wLen=tExpSmooth_tick(p->wlSmooth);
1818 Lfloat lowLen=pickP*wLen;
1819 Lfloat upLen=(1.0f-pickP)*wLen;
1820 tLinearDelay_setDelay(p->delLF, lowLen);
1821 tLinearDelay_setDelay(p->delLB, lowLen);
1822 tLinearDelay_setDelay(p->delUF, upLen);
1823 tLinearDelay_setDelay(p->delUB, upLen);
1824 p->curr = fromBridge;
1825 return p->curr;
1826}

1854void tLivingString2_init(tLivingString2* const pl, Lfloat freq, Lfloat pickPos, Lfloat prepPos, Lfloat pickupPos, Lfloat prepIndex,
1855 Lfloat brightness, Lfloat decay, Lfloat targetLev, Lfloat levSmoothFactor,
1856 Lfloat levStrength, int levMode, LEAF* const leaf)
1857{
1858 tLivingString2_initToPool(pl, freq, pickPos, prepPos, pickupPos, prepIndex, brightness, decay, targetLev, levSmoothFactor, levStrength, levMode, &leaf->mempool);
1859}
1860
1861void tLivingString2_initToPool (tLivingString2* const pl, Lfloat freq, Lfloat pickPos, Lfloat prepPos, Lfloat pickupPos, Lfloat prepIndex,
1862 Lfloat brightness, Lfloat decay, Lfloat targetLev, Lfloat levSmoothFactor,
1863 Lfloat levStrength, int levMode, tMempool* const mp)
1864{
1865 _tMempool* m = *mp;
1866 _tLivingString2* p = *pl = (_tLivingString2*) mpool_alloc(sizeof(_tLivingString2), m);
1867 p->mempool = m;
1868 LEAF* leaf = p->mempool->leaf;
1869
1870 p->sampleRate = leaf->sampleRate;
1871 p->curr=0.0f;
1872 tExpSmooth_initToPool(&p->wlSmooth, p->sampleRate/freq, 0.1f, mp); // smoother for string wavelength (not freq, to avoid expensive divisions)
1873 tLivingString2_setFreq(*pl, freq);
1874 p->freq = freq;
1875 p->prepPos = prepPos;
1876 tExpSmooth_initToPool(&p->ppSmooth, pickPos, 0.01f, mp); // smoother for pick position
1877 tExpSmooth_initToPool(&p->prpSmooth, prepPos, 0.01f, mp); // smoother for prep position
1878 tExpSmooth_initToPool(&p->puSmooth, pickupPos, 0.01f, mp); // smoother for pickup position
1879 tLivingString2_setPickPos(*pl, pickPos);
1880 tLivingString2_setPrepPos(*pl, prepPos);
1881 p->prepIndex = prepIndex;
1882 p->pickupPos = pickupPos;
1883 tHermiteDelay_initToPool(&p->delLF,p->waveLengthInSamples, 2400, mp);
1884 tHermiteDelay_initToPool(&p->delUF,p->waveLengthInSamples, 2400, mp);
1885 tHermiteDelay_initToPool(&p->delUB,p->waveLengthInSamples, 2400, mp);
1886 tHermiteDelay_initToPool(&p->delLB,p->waveLengthInSamples, 2400, mp);
1887 tHermiteDelay_clear(p->delLF);
1888 tHermiteDelay_clear(p->delUF);
1889 tHermiteDelay_clear(p->delUB);
1890 tHermiteDelay_clear(p->delLB);
1891 p->brightness = brightness;
1892 tTwoZero_initToPool(&p->bridgeFilter, mp);
1893 tTwoZero_initToPool(&p->nutFilter, mp);
1894 tTwoZero_initToPool(&p->prepFilterU, mp);
1895 tTwoZero_initToPool(&p->prepFilterL, mp);
1896 tLivingString2_setBrightness(p, brightness);
1897 tHighpass_initToPool(&p->DCblockerU,8, mp);
1898 tHighpass_initToPool(&p->DCblockerL,8, mp);
1899 p->decay=decay;
1900 p->prepIndex = prepIndex;
1901 tFeedbackLeveler_initToPool(&p->fbLevU, targetLev, levSmoothFactor, levStrength, levMode, mp);
1902 tFeedbackLeveler_initToPool(&p->fbLevL, targetLev, levSmoothFactor, levStrength, levMode, mp);
1903 p->levMode=levMode;
1904}

2022Lfloat tLivingString2_tick(tLivingString2 const p, Lfloat input)
2023{
2024 input = input * 0.5f; // drop gain by half since we'll be equally adding it at half amplitude to forward and backward waveguides
2025 // from prepPos upwards=forwards
2026 Lfloat wLen=tExpSmooth_tick(p->wlSmooth);
2027
2028 Lfloat pickP=tExpSmooth_tick(p->ppSmooth);
2029
2030 //Lfloat pickupPos=tExpSmooth_tick(&p->puSmooth);
2031
2032 //need to determine which delay line to put it into (should be half amplitude into forward and backward lines for the correct portion of string)
2033 Lfloat prepP=tExpSmooth_tick(p->prpSmooth);
2034 Lfloat lowLen=prepP*wLen;
2035 Lfloat upLen=(1.0f-prepP)*wLen;
2036 uint32_t pickPInt;
2037
2038 if (pickP > prepP)
2039 {
2040 Lfloat fullPickPoint = ((pickP*wLen) - lowLen);
2041 pickPInt = (uint32_t) fullPickPoint; // where does the input go? that's the pick point
2042 Lfloat pickPLfloat = fullPickPoint - pickPInt;
2043
2044 tHermiteDelay_addTo(p->delUF, input * (1.0f - pickPLfloat), pickPInt);
2045 tHermiteDelay_addTo(p->delUF, input * pickPLfloat, pickPInt + 1);
2046 tHermiteDelay_addTo(p->delUB, input * (1.0f - pickPLfloat), (uint32_t) (upLen - pickPInt));
2047 tHermiteDelay_addTo(p->delUB, input * pickPLfloat, (uint32_t) (upLen - pickPInt - 1));
2048 }
2049 else
2050 {
2051 Lfloat fullPickPoint = pickP * wLen;
2052 pickPInt = (uint32_t) fullPickPoint; // where does the input go? that's the pick point
2053 Lfloat pickPLfloat = fullPickPoint - pickPInt;
2054
2055 tHermiteDelay_addTo(p->delLF, input * (1.0f - pickPLfloat), pickPInt);
2056 tHermiteDelay_addTo(p->delLF, input * pickPLfloat, pickPInt + 1);
2057 tHermiteDelay_addTo(p->delLB, input * (1.0f - pickPLfloat), (uint32_t) (lowLen - pickPInt));
2058 tHermiteDelay_addTo(p->delLB, input * pickPLfloat, (uint32_t) (lowLen - pickPInt - 1));
2059 }
2060/*
2061 if (pickP > prepP)
2062 {
2063 Lfloat fullPickPoint = ((pickP*wLen) - lowLen);
2064 pickPInt = (uint32_t) fullPickPoint; // where does the input go? that's the pick point
2065
2066 tHermiteDelay_addTo(&p->delUF, input, pickPInt);
2067 tHermiteDelay_addTo(&p->delUB, input, (uint32_t) (upLen - pickPInt));
2068 }
2069 else
2070 {
2071 Lfloat fullPickPoint = pickP * wLen;
2072 pickPInt = (uint32_t) fullPickPoint; // where does the input go? that's the pick point
2073
2074 tHermiteDelay_addTo(&p->delLF, input, pickPInt);
2075 tHermiteDelay_addTo(&p->delLB, input, (uint32_t) (lowLen - pickPInt));
2076 }
2077*/
2078 Lfloat fromLF=tHermiteDelay_tickOut(p->delLF);
2079 Lfloat fromUF=tHermiteDelay_tickOut(p->delUF);
2080 Lfloat fromUB=tHermiteDelay_tickOut(p->delUB);
2081 Lfloat fromLB=tHermiteDelay_tickOut(p->delLB);
2082 fromLB = LEAF_clip(-1.0f, fromLB, 1.0f);
2083 fromUB = LEAF_clip(-1.0f, fromUB, 1.0f);
2084 fromUF = LEAF_clip(-1.0f, fromUF, 1.0f);
2085 fromLF = LEAF_clip(-1.0f, fromLF, 1.0f);
2086
2087 // into upper half of string, from bridge, going backwards
2088 Lfloat fromBridge=-tFeedbackLeveler_tick(p->fbLevU, (p->levMode==0?p->decay:1.0f)*tHighpass_tick(p->DCblockerU, tTwoZero_tick(p->bridgeFilter, fromUF)));
2089 fromBridge = LEAF_clip(-1.0f, fromBridge, 1.0f);
2090 tHermiteDelay_tickIn(p->delUB, fromBridge);
2091 // into lower half of string, from prepPoint, going backwards
2092 Lfloat fromLowerPrep=-tTwoZero_tick(p->prepFilterL, fromLF);
2093 fromLowerPrep = LEAF_clip(-1.0f, fromLowerPrep, 1.0f);
2094 Lfloat intoLower=p->prepIndex*fromLowerPrep+(1.0f - p->prepIndex)*fromUB; //used to add input here
2095 intoLower = LEAF_clip(-1.0f, intoLower, 1.0f);
2096 tHermiteDelay_tickIn(p->delLB, intoLower);
2097 // into lower half of string, from nut
2098 Lfloat fromNut=-tFeedbackLeveler_tick(p->fbLevL, (p->levMode==0?p->decay:1.0f)*tHighpass_tick(p->DCblockerL, tTwoZero_tick(p->nutFilter, fromLB)));
2099 fromNut = LEAF_clip(-1.0f, fromNut, 1.0f);
2100 tHermiteDelay_tickIn(p->delLF, fromNut);
2101 // into upper half of string, from prepPoint, going forwards/upwards
2102 Lfloat fromUpperPrep=-tTwoZero_tick(p->prepFilterU, fromUB);
2103 fromUpperPrep = LEAF_clip(-1.0f, fromUpperPrep, 1.0f);
2104 Lfloat intoUpper=p->prepIndex*fromUpperPrep+(1.0f - p->prepIndex)*fromLF;
2105 //intoUpper = tanhf(intoUpper);
2106 intoUpper = LEAF_clip(-1.0f, intoUpper, 1.0f);
2107 tHermiteDelay_tickIn(p->delUF, intoUpper);
2108 // update all delay lengths
2109
2110 tHermiteDelay_setDelay(p->delLF, lowLen);
2111 tHermiteDelay_setDelay(p->delLB, lowLen);
2112 tHermiteDelay_setDelay(p->delUF, upLen);
2113 tHermiteDelay_setDelay(p->delUB, upLen);
2114
2115 uint32_t PUPInt;
2116 Lfloat pickupOut = 0.0f;
2117 Lfloat pupos = tExpSmooth_tick(p->puSmooth);
2118 if (pupos < 0.9999f)
2119 {
2120 if (pupos > prepP)
2121 {
2122 Lfloat fullPUPoint = ((pupos*wLen) - lowLen);
2123 PUPInt = (uint32_t) fullPUPoint; // where does the input go? that's the pick point
2124 Lfloat PUPLfloat = fullPUPoint - PUPInt;
2125
2126 pickupOut = tHermiteDelay_tapOut(p->delUF, PUPInt) * (1.0f - PUPLfloat);
2127 pickupOut += tHermiteDelay_tapOut(p->delUF, PUPInt + 1) * PUPLfloat;
2128 pickupOut += tHermiteDelay_tapOut(p->delUB, (uint32_t) (upLen - PUPInt)) * (1.0f - PUPLfloat);
2129 pickupOut += tHermiteDelay_tapOut(p->delUB, (uint32_t) (upLen - PUPInt - 1)) * PUPLfloat;
2130 }
2131 else
2132 {
2133 Lfloat fullPUPoint = pupos * wLen;
2134 PUPInt = (uint32_t) fullPUPoint; // where does the input go? that's the pick point
2135 Lfloat PUPLfloat = fullPUPoint - PUPInt;
2136
2137 pickupOut = tHermiteDelay_tapOut(p->delLF, PUPInt) * (1.0f - PUPLfloat);
2138 pickupOut += tHermiteDelay_tapOut(p->delLF, PUPInt + 1) * PUPLfloat;
2139 pickupOut += tHermiteDelay_tapOut(p->delLB, (uint32_t) (lowLen - PUPInt)) * (1.0f - PUPLfloat);
2140 pickupOut += tHermiteDelay_tapOut(p->delLB, (uint32_t) (lowLen - PUPInt - 1)) * PUPLfloat;
2141 }
2142
2143 p->curr = pickupOut;
2144
2145
2146
2147
2148/*
2149 Lfloat fullPickupPos = (pupos*upLen);
2150 pickupPosInt = (uint32_t) fullPickupPos;
2151 Lfloat pickupPosLfloat = fullPickupPos - pickupPosInt;
2152 if (pickupPosInt == 0)
2153 {
2154 pickupPosInt = 1;
2155 }
2156 pickupOut = tHermiteDelay_tapOutInterpolated(&p->delUF, pickupPosInt, pickupPosLfloat);
2157 pickupOut += tHermiteDelay_tapOutInterpolated(&p->delUB, (uint32_t) (upLen - pickupPosInt), pickupPosLfloat);
2158 p->curr = pickupOut;
2159 */
2160 }
2161 else
2162
2163 {
2164 p->curr = fromBridge;
2165 }
2166
2167 //p->curr = fromBridge;
2168 //p->curr += fromNut;
2169
2170 return p->curr;
2171}

2173Lfloat tLivingString2_tickEfficient(tLivingString2 const p, Lfloat input)
2174{
2175 input = input * 0.5f; // drop gain by half since we'll be equally adding it at half amplitude to forward and backward waveguides
2176 // from prepPos upwards=forwards
2177 //Lfloat pickupPos=tExpSmooth_tick(&p->puSmooth);
2178 Lfloat wLen = p->wlSmooth->dest;
2179
2180 Lfloat pickP = p->ppSmooth->dest;
2181
2182 //need to determine which delay line to put it into (should be half amplitude into forward and backward lines for the correct portion of string)
2183 Lfloat prepP = p->prpSmooth->dest;
2184 Lfloat lowLen=p->prpSmooth->dest*p->wlSmooth->dest;
2185 Lfloat upLen=(1.0f-p->prpSmooth->dest)*p->wlSmooth->dest;
2186 uint32_t pickPInt;
2187 if (pickP > prepP)
2188 {
2189 Lfloat fullPickPoint = ((pickP*wLen) - lowLen);
2190 pickPInt = (uint32_t) fullPickPoint; // where does the input go? that's the pick point
2191
2192 tHermiteDelay_addTo(p->delUF, input, pickPInt);
2193 tHermiteDelay_addTo(p->delUB, input, (uint32_t) (upLen - pickPInt));
2194 }
2195 else
2196 {
2197 Lfloat fullPickPoint = pickP * wLen;
2198 pickPInt = (uint32_t) fullPickPoint; // where does the input go? that's the pick point
2199
2200 tHermiteDelay_addTo(p->delLF, input, pickPInt);
2201 tHermiteDelay_addTo(p->delLB, input, (uint32_t) (lowLen - pickPInt));
2202 }
2203 Lfloat fromLF=tHermiteDelay_tickOut(p->delLF);
2204 Lfloat fromUF=tHermiteDelay_tickOut(p->delUF);
2205 Lfloat fromUB=tHermiteDelay_tickOut(p->delUB);
2206 Lfloat fromLB=tHermiteDelay_tickOut(p->delLB);
2207 // into upper half of string, from bridge, going backwards
2208 //Lfloat fromBridge=-tFeedbackLeveler_tick(&p->fbLevU, (p->levMode==0?p->decay:1.0f)*tHighpass_tick(&p->DCblockerU, tTwoZero_tick(&p->bridgeFilter, fromUF)));
2209 Lfloat fromBridge=-tFeedbackLeveler_tick(p->fbLevU,tHighpass_tick(p->DCblockerU, tTwoZero_tick(p->bridgeFilter, fromUF)));
2210 tHermiteDelay_tickIn(p->delUB, fromBridge);
2211 // into lower half of string, from prepPoint, going backwards
2212 Lfloat fromLowerPrep=-tTwoZero_tick(p->prepFilterL, fromLF);
2213 Lfloat intoLower=(p->prepIndex*fromLowerPrep)+((1.0f - p->prepIndex)*fromUB); //used to add input here
2214 tHermiteDelay_tickIn(p->delLB, intoLower);
2215 // into lower half of string, from nut
2216 //Lfloat fromNut=-tFeedbackLeveler_tick(&p->fbLevL, (p->levMode==0?p->decay:1.0f)*tHighpass_tick(&p->DCblockerL, tTwoZero_tick(&p->nutFilter, fromLB)));
2217 Lfloat fromNut=-tFeedbackLeveler_tick(p->fbLevL,tHighpass_tick(p->DCblockerL, tTwoZero_tick(p->nutFilter, fromLB)));
2218 tHermiteDelay_tickIn(p->delLF, fromNut);
2219 // into upper half of string, from prepPoint, going forwards/upwards
2220 Lfloat fromUpperPrep=-tTwoZero_tick(p->prepFilterU, fromUB);
2221 Lfloat intoUpper=(p->prepIndex*fromUpperPrep)+((1.0f - p->prepIndex)*fromLF);
2222 tHermiteDelay_tickIn(p->delUF, intoUpper);
2223 // update all delay lengths
2224
2225 p->curr = fromBridge;
2226
2227 //p->curr = fromBridge;
2228 //p->curr += fromNut;
2229
2230 return p->curr;
2231}

2237
2238 Lfloat lowLen=p->prpSmooth->dest*p->wlSmooth->dest;

2240

2270void tComplexLivingString_init(tComplexLivingString* const pl, Lfloat freq, Lfloat pickPos, Lfloat prepPos, Lfloat prepIndex,
2271 Lfloat dampFreq, Lfloat decay, Lfloat targetLev, Lfloat levSmoothFactor,
2272 Lfloat levStrength, int levMode, LEAF* const leaf)

2274 tComplexLivingString_initToPool(pl, freq, pickPos, prepPos, prepIndex, dampFreq, decay, targetLev, levSmoothFactor, levStrength, levMode, &leaf->mempool);

2277void tComplexLivingString_initToPool (tComplexLivingString* const pl, Lfloat freq, Lfloat pickPos, Lfloat prepPos, Lfloat prepIndex,
2278 Lfloat dampFreq, Lfloat decay, Lfloat targetLev, Lfloat levSmoothFactor,
2279 Lfloat levStrength, int levMode, tMempool* const mp)
2280{
2281 _tMempool* m = *mp;
2282 _tComplexLivingString* p = *pl = (_tComplexLivingString*) mpool_alloc(sizeof(_tComplexLivingString), m);
2283 p->mempool = m;
2284 LEAF* leaf = p->mempool->leaf;
2285
2286 p->sampleRate = leaf->sampleRate;
2287 p->curr=0.0f;
2288 tExpSmooth_initToPool(&p->wlSmooth, p->sampleRate/freq, 0.01f, mp); // smoother for string wavelength (not freq, to avoid expensive divisions)
2289 tComplexLivingString_setFreq(*pl, freq);
2290 p->freq = freq;
2291 tExpSmooth_initToPool(&p->pickPosSmooth, pickPos, 0.01f, mp); // smoother for pick position
2292 tExpSmooth_initToPool(&p->prepPosSmooth, prepPos, 0.01f, mp); // smoother for pick position
2293
2294 tComplexLivingString_setPickPos(*pl, pickPos);
2295 tComplexLivingString_setPrepPos(*pl, prepPos);
2296
2297 p->prepPos=prepPos;
2298 p->pickPos=pickPos;
2299 tLinearDelay_initToPool(&p->delLF,p->waveLengthInSamples, 2400, mp);
2300 tLinearDelay_initToPool(&p->delMF,p->waveLengthInSamples, 2400, mp);
2301 tLinearDelay_initToPool(&p->delUF,p->waveLengthInSamples, 2400, mp);
2302 tLinearDelay_initToPool(&p->delUB,p->waveLengthInSamples, 2400, mp);
2303 tLinearDelay_initToPool(&p->delMB,p->waveLengthInSamples, 2400, mp);
2304 tLinearDelay_initToPool(&p->delLB,p->waveLengthInSamples, 2400, mp);
2305 tLinearDelay_clear(p->delLF);
2306 tLinearDelay_clear(p->delMF);
2307 tLinearDelay_clear(p->delUF);
2308 tLinearDelay_clear(p->delUB);
2309 tLinearDelay_clear(p->delMB);
2310 tLinearDelay_clear(p->delLB);
2311 p->dampFreq = dampFreq;
2312 tOnePole_initToPool(&p->bridgeFilter, dampFreq, mp);
2313 tOnePole_initToPool(&p->nutFilter, dampFreq, mp);
2314 tOnePole_initToPool(&p->prepFilterU, dampFreq, mp);
2315 tOnePole_initToPool(&p->prepFilterL, dampFreq, mp);
2316 tHighpass_initToPool(&p->DCblockerU, 13, mp);
2317 tHighpass_initToPool(&p->DCblockerL, 13, mp);
2318 p->decay=decay;
2319 p->prepIndex = prepIndex;
2320 tFeedbackLeveler_initToPool(&p->fbLevU, targetLev, levSmoothFactor, levStrength, levMode, mp);
2321 tFeedbackLeveler_initToPool(&p->fbLevL, targetLev, levSmoothFactor, levStrength, levMode, mp);
2322 p->levMode=levMode;
2323}

2427Lfloat tComplexLivingString_tick(tComplexLivingString const p, Lfloat input)
2428{
2429 // from pickPos upwards=forwards
2430 Lfloat fromLF=tLinearDelay_tickOut(p->delLF);
2431 Lfloat fromMF=tLinearDelay_tickOut(p->delMF);
2432 Lfloat fromUF=tLinearDelay_tickOut(p->delUF);
2433 Lfloat fromUB=tLinearDelay_tickOut(p->delUB);
2434 Lfloat fromMB=tLinearDelay_tickOut(p->delMB);
2435 Lfloat fromLB=tLinearDelay_tickOut(p->delLB);
2436
2437 // into upper part of string, from bridge, going backwards
2438 Lfloat fromBridge=-tFeedbackLeveler_tick(p->fbLevU, (p->levMode==0?p->decay:1)*tHighpass_tick(p->DCblockerU, tOnePole_tick(p->bridgeFilter, fromUF)));
2439 tLinearDelay_tickIn(p->delUB, fromBridge);
2440
2441 // into pick position, take input and add it into the waveguide, going to come out of middle segment
2442 tLinearDelay_tickIn(p->delMB, fromUB+input);
2443
2444 // into lower part of string, from prepPos, going backwards
2445 Lfloat fromLowerPrep=-tOnePole_tick(p->prepFilterL, fromLF);
2446 Lfloat intoLower=p->prepIndex*fromLowerPrep+(1.0f - p->prepIndex)*fromMB;
2447 tLinearDelay_tickIn(p->delLB, intoLower);
2448
2449 // into lower part of string, from nut, going forwards toward prep position
2450 Lfloat fromNut=-tFeedbackLeveler_tick(p->fbLevL, (p->levMode==0?p->decay:1.0f)*tHighpass_tick(p->DCblockerL, tOnePole_tick(p->nutFilter, fromLB)));
2451 tLinearDelay_tickIn(p->delLF, fromNut);
2452
2453 // into middle part of string, from prep going toward pick position
2454 Lfloat fromUpperPrep=-tOnePole_tick(p->prepFilterU, fromMB);
2455 Lfloat intoMiddle=p->prepIndex*fromUpperPrep+(1.0f - p->prepIndex)*fromLF;
2456
2457 //pick position, going to come out of middle segment
2458 tLinearDelay_tickIn(p->delMF, intoMiddle);
2459
2460 //take output of middle segment and put it into upper segment connecting to the bridge, take input and add it into the waveguide,
2461 tLinearDelay_tickIn(p->delUF, fromMF + input);
2462
2463 // update all delay lengths
2464 Lfloat pickP=tExpSmooth_tick(p->pickPosSmooth);
2465 Lfloat prepP=tExpSmooth_tick(p->prepPosSmooth);
2466 Lfloat wLen=tExpSmooth_tick(p->wlSmooth);
2467
2468 Lfloat midLen = (pickP-prepP) * wLen; // the length between the pick and the prep;
2469 Lfloat lowLen = prepP*wLen; // the length from prep to nut
2470 Lfloat upLen = (1.0f-pickP)*wLen; // the length from pick to bridge
2471
2472
2473 tLinearDelay_setDelay(p->delLF, lowLen);
2474 tLinearDelay_setDelay(p->delLB, lowLen);
2475
2476 tLinearDelay_setDelay(p->delMF, midLen);
2477 tLinearDelay_setDelay(p->delMB, midLen);
2478
2479 tLinearDelay_setDelay(p->delUF, upLen);
2480 tLinearDelay_setDelay(p->delUB, upLen);
2481
2482 //update this to allow pickup position variation
2483 p->curr = fromBridge;
2484 return p->curr;
2485}

2489 return p->curr;

2492void tComplexLivingString_setSampleRate(tComplexLivingString const p, Lfloat sr)
2493{

2497 tExpSmooth_setDest(p->wlSmooth, p->waveLengthInSamples);
2498 tOnePole_setSampleRate(p->bridgeFilter, p->sampleRate);
2499 tOnePole_setSampleRate(p->nutFilter, p->sampleRate);
2500 tOnePole_setSampleRate(p->prepFilterU, p->sampleRate);
2501 tOnePole_setSampleRate(p->prepFilterL, p->sampleRate);
2502 tHighpass_setSampleRate(p->DCblockerU, p->sampleRate);
2503 tHighpass_setSampleRate(p->DCblockerL, p->sampleRate);
2504}

2511void tBowed_initToPool (tBowed* const bw, int oversampling, tMempool* const mp)
2512{
2513 _tMempool* m = *mp;
2514 _tBowed* x = *bw = (_tBowed*) mpool_alloc(sizeof(_tBowed), m);
2515 x->mempool = m;
2516 LEAF* leaf = x->mempool->leaf;
2517
2518 x->x_bp = 01.6f;
2519 x->x_bpos = 0.2f;
2520 x->x_bv = .9f;
2521 x->x_fr = 440.f;
2522 x->oversampling = oversampling;
2523 x->sampleRate = leaf->sampleRate * oversampling;
2524 x->invSampleRate = 1.f / (x->sampleRate * oversampling);
2525
2526 tLinearDelay_initToPool(&x->neckDelay, 100.0f, 2400.0f, mp);
2527 tLinearDelay_initToPool(&x->bridgeDelay, 29.0f, 2400.0f, mp);
2528 tLinearDelay_clear(x->neckDelay);
2529 tLinearDelay_clear(x->bridgeDelay);
2530 tCookOnePole_initToPool(&x->reflFilt, mp);
2531 tCookOnePole_setSampleRate(x->reflFilt, x->sampleRate);
2532
2533 tCookOnePole_setPole(x->reflFilt, 0.6f - (0.1f * 22050.f / x->sampleRate));
2534 tCookOnePole_setGain(x->reflFilt, .95f);
2535 tBowTable_initToPool(&x->bowTabl, mp);
2536 x->bowTabl->slope = 3.0f;
2537 tBowed_setFreq(x, x->x_fr);
2538
2539 tSVF_initToPool(&x->lowpass, SVFTypeLowpass, 18000.0f, 0.6f, mp);
2540 tSVF_setSampleRate(x->lowpass, x->sampleRate);
2541 tSVF_setFreq(x->lowpass,16000.0f);
2542 x->betaRatio = 0.127236;
2543 x->fr_save = x->x_fr;
2544
2545}

2547void tBowed_free (tBowed* const bw)
2548{
2549 _tBowed* x = *bw;
2550 tLinearDelay_free(&x->neckDelay);
2551 tLinearDelay_free(&x->bridgeDelay);
2552 tCookOnePole_free(&x->reflFilt);

2554}
2555
2556Lfloat tBowed_tick (tBowed const x)
2557{
2558 float bp = x->x_bp;
2559 float bpos = x->x_bpos;
2560 float bv = x->x_bv;
2561 float fr = x->x_fr;
2562 float nutRefl, newVel, velDiff, stringVel, bridgeRefl;
2563 if (fr != x->fr_save) {
2564 tBowed_setFreq(x, fr);
2565 x->fr_save = fr;
2566 }
2567
2568 x->bowTabl->slope = bp;
2569
2570 if (bpos != x->betaRatio) {
2571 x->betaRatio = bpos;
2572 tLinearDelay_setDelay(x->bridgeDelay, x->baseDelay * x->betaRatio); /* bow to bridge length */
2573 tLinearDelay_setDelay(x->neckDelay, x->baseDelay * (1. - x->betaRatio)); /* bow to nut (finger) length */
2574
2575
2576 for (int i = 0; i < x->oversampling; i++) {
2577 bridgeRefl = -tCookOnePole_tick(x->reflFilt, x->bridgeDelay->lastOut); /* Bridge Reflection */
2578 nutRefl = x->neckDelay->lastOut; /* Nut Reflection */
2579 stringVel = bridgeRefl + nutRefl; /* Sum is String Velocity */
2580 velDiff = bv - stringVel; /* Differential Velocity */
2581 newVel = velDiff * tBowTable_lookup(x->bowTabl, velDiff); /* Non-Lin Bow Function */
2582 tLinearDelay_tick(x->neckDelay, bridgeRefl + newVel); /* Do string */
2583 tLinearDelay_tick(x->bridgeDelay, nutRefl + newVel); /* propagations */
2584 x->output = tSVF_tick(x->lowpass, x->bridgeDelay->lastOut);
2585 }
2586
2587 return x->output;
2588 }
2589}
2590
2591void tBowed_setFreq (tBowed const x, Lfloat freq)
2592{
2593 if (freq < 20.f)
2594 freq = 20.f;
2595 x->baseDelay = (x->sampleRate / freq) - 4.0; /* delay - approx. filter delay */
2596 tLinearDelay_setDelay(x->bridgeDelay, x->baseDelay * x->betaRatio); /* bow to bridge length */
2597 tLinearDelay_setDelay(x->neckDelay, x->baseDelay * (1. - x->betaRatio)); /* bow to nut (finger) length */
2598}

2606void tTString_initToPool (tTString* const bw, int oversampling, Lfloat lowestFreq, tMempool* const mp)
2607{
2608 _tMempool* m = *mp;
2609 _tTString* x = *bw = (_tTString*) mpool_alloc(sizeof(_tTString), m);
2610 x->mempool = m;
2611 LEAF* leaf = x->mempool->leaf;
2612
2613 x->oversampling = oversampling;
2614 x->invOversampling = 1.0f / oversampling;
2615 x->invOversamplingTimesTwo = x->invOversampling * 2.0f;
2616 x->sampleRate = leaf->sampleRate * oversampling;
2617 x->invSampleRate = 1.f / x->sampleRate;
2618 x->invSampleRateTimesTwoPi = TWO_PI * x->invSampleRate;
2619 x->tensionGain = 0.0f;
2620 x->allpassDelay = 0.f;
2621 x->decayCoeff = 1.0f;
2622 x->muteCoeff = 1.0f;
2623 x->output = 0.0f;
2624 x->outputP = 0.0f;
2625 x->rippleRate = 1.0f;
2626 x->r = 0.0f;
2627 x->invOnePlusr = 1.0f;
2628 x->decayInSeconds = 10.0f;
2629 x->harmonic = 1.0f;
2630 x->baseDelay = 100.0f;
2631
2632 x->tensionAmount = 0.0f;
2633
2634 x->pickupPos = 0.0f;
2635 x->slideGain = 0.4f;
2636 x->barDrive = 1.5f;
2637 x->wound = 1;
2638 x->barPulsePhasor = 0;
2639 Lfloat maxDelayTemp = x->sampleRate / lowestFreq;
2640 tLagrangeDelay_initToPool(&x->delay, 100.0f, maxDelayTemp, mp);
2641 x->actualLowestFreq = x->sampleRate / tLagrangeDelay_getMaxDelay (x->delay); //adjusted to create a power-of-two size buffer
2642
2643 tLagrangeDelay_clear(x->delay);
2644 tLagrangeDelay_initToPool(&x->delayP, 100.0f, maxDelayTemp, mp);
2645 tLagrangeDelay_clear(x->delayP);
2646
2647 x->maxDelay = tLagrangeDelay_getMaxDelay (x->delay);
2648
2649 tCookOnePole_initToPool(&x->reflFilt, mp);
2650 tCookOnePole_setSampleRate(x->reflFilt, x->sampleRate);
2651 tCookOnePole_initToPool(&x->reflFiltP, mp);
2652 tCookOnePole_setSampleRate(x->reflFiltP, x->sampleRate);
2653
2654 tCookOnePole_setGainAndPole(x->reflFilt,0.999f, -0.0014f);
2655 tCookOnePole_setGainAndPole(x->reflFiltP,0.999f, -0.0014f);
2656
2657 tTString_setFreq(x, 440.0f);
2658
2659 tExpSmooth_initToPool(&x->tensionSmoother, 0.0f, 0.004f * x->invOversampling, mp);
2660 tExpSmooth_setDest(x->tensionSmoother, 0.0f);
2661 tExpSmooth_initToPool(&x->pitchSmoother, 100.0f, 0.04f * x->invOversampling, mp);
2662 tExpSmooth_setDest(x->pitchSmoother, 100.0f);
2663 tExpSmooth_initToPool(&x->pickNoise, 0.0f, 0.09f * x->invOversampling, mp);
2664 tExpSmooth_setDest(x->pickNoise, 0.0f);
2665 tThiranAllpassSOCascade_initToPool(&x->allpass, 4, mp);
2666 tThiranAllpassSOCascade_initToPool(&x->allpassP, 4, mp);
2667 x->allpassDelay = tThiranAllpassSOCascade_setCoeff(x->allpass, 0.0001f, 100.0f, x->invOversampling);
2668 x->allpassDelayP = tThiranAllpassSOCascade_setCoeff(x->allpassP, 0.000025f, 100.0f, x->invOversampling);
2669
2670 tSVF_initToPool(&x->lowpassP, SVFTypeLowpass, 5000.0f, 0.8f, mp);
2671 tSVF_setSampleRate(x->lowpassP, x->sampleRate);
2672 tSVF_setFreq(x->lowpassP, 6000.0f);
2673 tSVF_initToPool(&x->highpassP, SVFTypeHighpass, 1800.0f, 0.8f, mp);
2674 tSVF_setSampleRate(x->highpassP, x->sampleRate);
2675 tSVF_setFreq(x->highpassP, 1800.0f);
2676 x->twoPiTimesInvSampleRate = TWO_PI * x->invSampleRate;
2677 tCycle_initToPool(&x->tensionModOsc, mp);
2678 tCycle_setSampleRate(x->tensionModOsc, x->sampleRate);
2679 tCycle_initToPool(&x->pickupModOsc, mp);
2680 tCycle_setSampleRate(x->pickupModOsc, x->sampleRate);
2681 x->pickupModOscFreq = 440.0f;
2682 x->pickupModOscAmp = 1.0f;
2683 tSVF_initToPool(&x->pickupFilter, SVFTypeLowpass, 2900.0f, 1.0f, mp);
2684 tSVF_setSampleRate(x->pickupFilter, x->sampleRate);
2685
2686 tSVF_setFreq(x->pickupFilter, 3900.0f);
2687
2688 tSVF_initToPool(&x->pickupFilter2, SVFTypeLowpass, 3800.0f, 1.1f, mp);
2689 tSVF_setSampleRate(x->pickupFilter2, x->sampleRate);
2690
2691 tSVF_setFreq(x->pickupFilter2, 4100.0f);
2692
2693
2694 tSVF_initToPool(&x->peakFilt, SVFTypePeak, 1000.0f, .9f, mp);
2695 tSVF_setSampleRate(x->peakFilt, x->sampleRate);
2696
2697 tSVF_setFreq(x->peakFilt, 1000.0f);
2698
2699 tNoise_initToPool(&x->noise, PinkNoise, mp);
2700 tHighpass_initToPool(&x->dcBlock, 1.0f, mp);
2701 tHighpass_setSampleRate(x->dcBlock,x->sampleRate);
2702 tHighpass_initToPool(&x->dcBlockP, 1.0f, mp);
2703 tHighpass_setSampleRate(x->dcBlockP,x->sampleRate);
2704 tSlide_initToPool(&x->slide, 0, 3000, mp);//100 1400
2705 if (x->wound)
2706 {
2707
2708 tExpSmooth_initToPool(&x->barSmooth2, 0.0f,0.0005f, mp); //was 0.0005
2709 tExpSmooth_setDest(x->barSmooth2, 0.0f);
2710 tExpSmooth_initToPool(&x->barSmoothVol, 0.0f,0.0008f, mp); //was 0.008
2711 tExpSmooth_setDest(x->barSmoothVol, 0.0f);
2712 }
2713 else
2714 {
2715
2716 tExpSmooth_initToPool(&x->barSmooth2, 0.0f,0.005f, mp); //was 0.0005
2717 tExpSmooth_setDest(x->barSmooth2, 0.0f);
2718 tExpSmooth_initToPool(&x->barSmoothVol, 0.0f,0.004f, mp); //was 0.008
2719 tExpSmooth_setDest(x->barSmoothVol, 0.0f);
2720 }
2721 tSlide_initToPool(&x->barSmooth, 1000, 1000, mp);//600 600
2722 tSlide_initToPool(&x->barPulseSlide, 2, 30, mp);//100 1400 // 10 3000
2723 tExpSmooth_initToPool(&x->barPulse, 0.0f,0.05f, mp); //was 0.05
2724 tExpSmooth_setDest(x->barPulse, 0.0f);
2725
2726
2727 tSVF_initToPool(&x->barResonator, SVFTypeBandpass, 5.0f, 15.0f, mp);
2728
2729 x->timeSinceLastBump = 1;
2730 tHighpass_initToPool(&x->barHP, 30.0f, mp);
2731 tSVF_initToPool(&x->barLP, SVFTypeLowpass, 7000.0f, 0.9f, mp);
2732
2733 x->inharmonic = 1;
2734 x->inharmonicMult = 1.0f;
2735 tFeedbackLeveler_initToPool(&x->feedback, 0.25f, 0.04f * x->invOversampling, 0.1f, 1, mp);
2736 tFeedbackLeveler_initToPool(&x->feedbackP, 0.25f, 0.04f * x->invOversampling, 0.1f, 1, mp);
2737 x->quarterSampleRate = x->sampleRate * 0.245f; // a little less than a quarter because we want to compute filters with it ( normalized filter cutoff needs to be less than half pi to work with freq approximation)
2738 x->windingsPerInch = 70.0f;
2739
2740 tNoise_initToPool(&x->pickNoiseSource, PinkNoise, mp);
2741 x->pickupAmount = 0.0f;
2742 tPickupNonLinearity_initToPool(&x->p, mp);
2743}

2783Lfloat tTString_tick (tTString const x)
2784{
2785 Lfloat theOutput = 0.0f;
2786 x->feedbackNoise = tNoise_tick(x->noise);
2787
2788 Lfloat barPos = x->barPosition;
2789 if ((barPos > (x->prevBarPosSmoothed + 3.0f)) || (barPos < (x->prevBarPosSmoothed - 3.0f)))
2790 {
2791 tExpSmooth_setValAndDest(x->barSmooth2,barPos);
2792 }
2793 else
2794 {
2795 tExpSmooth_setDest(x->barSmooth2,barPos);
2796 }
2797
2798 //Lfloat currentBumpSmoothed = currentBump;
2799 Lfloat barPosSmoothed = tExpSmooth_tick(x->barSmooth2);
2800
2801 Lfloat barDifference = fastabsf(barPosSmoothed - x->prevBarPosSmoothed);
2802
2803
2804 tExpSmooth_setDest(x->barSmoothVol,barPos);
2805 Lfloat barPosSmoothVol = tExpSmooth_tick(x->barSmoothVol);
2806 Lfloat differenceFastSmooth = fastabsf(barPosSmoothVol - x->prevBarPosSmoothVol);
2807 x->prevBarPosSmoothVol = barPosSmoothVol;
2808 Lfloat volCut = 1.0f;
2809 if (differenceFastSmooth < 0.0001f)
2810 {
2811 //volCut = LEAF_map(differenceFastSmooth, 0.00001f, 0.0001f, 0.0f, 1.0f);
2812 volCut = ((differenceFastSmooth - 0.00001f) * 1111.111111111111111f);
2813 if (volCut < 0.0f)
2814 {
2815 volCut = 0.0f;
2816 }
2817 }
2818 Lfloat currentBump = barPosSmoothed * x->windingsPerInch;
2819 Lfloat bumpDifference = fastabsf(currentBump - x->lastBump);
2820
2821 x->prevBarPosSmoothed = barPosSmoothed;
2822 barDifference = LEAF_clip(0.0f, barDifference*2.0f, 1.0f);
2823 x->slideAmount = tSlide_tick(x->slide, barDifference);
2824 if (x->wound)
2825 {
2826 if (bumpDifference > 1.0f)
2827 {
2828 tExpSmooth_setVal(x->barPulse, 1.0f);
2829
2830 tSlide_setDest(x->barPulseSlide, 1.0f);
2831
2832 x->lastBump = currentBump;
2833 x->timeSinceLastBump = x->sampleCount+1 / bumpDifference;
2834 if (x->timeSinceLastBump < 100)
2835 {
2836 x->bumpOsc = 1;
2837 }
2838 else
2839 {
2840 x->bumpOsc = 0;
2841 }
2842
2843 tSlide_setDest(x->barSmooth, (x->sampleRate * x->invOversampling / x->timeSinceLastBump));
2844 x->sampleCount = 0;
2845 }
2846 else
2847 {
2848 x->bumpOsc = 0;
2849 }
2850
2851 if (x->bumpOsc)
2852 {
2853 if (x->bumpCount > x->timeSinceLastBump)
2854 {
2855 tExpSmooth_setVal(x->barPulse, 1.0f);
2856 tSlide_setDest(x->barPulseSlide, 1.0f);
2857 x->bumpCount = 0;
2858 }
2859 x->bumpCount++;
2860 }
2861
2862 if (x->sampleCount < 3000)
2863 {
2864 x->sampleCount++;
2865
2866 }
2867 else
2868 {
2869 tSlide_setDest(x->barSmooth, 5.0f);
2870 }
2871 Lfloat barFreq = tSlide_tickNoInput(x->barSmooth);
2872 tSVF_setFreq(x->barResonator, barFreq);
2873 Lfloat filterAmount = 0.5f;
2874 Lfloat dryAmount = 1.0f;
2875 x->slideNoise = x->feedbackNoise;
2876
2877 Lfloat pulseVal = tSlide_tickNoInput(x->barPulseSlide);
2878
2879 if (pulseVal > .99f)
2880 {
2881 tSlide_setDest(x->barPulseSlide, 0.0f);
2882
2883 }
2884
2885 x->slideNoise *= pulseVal;
2886 //x->slideNoise = tExpSmooth_tick(&x->barPulse);
2887 x->slideNoise *= tExpSmooth_tick(x->barPulse);
2888 //x->slideNoise *= x->slideGain;
2889 Lfloat tempSlideNoise1 = x->slideNoise;
2890 Lfloat tempSlideNoise2 = fast_tanh5(tSVF_tick(x->barResonator, tempSlideNoise1)*x->barDrive);
2891
2892 Lfloat filterFade = 1.0f;
2893 if (barFreq < 300.0f)
2894 {
2895 //filterFade = LEAF_map(barFreq, 100.0f, 300.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f);
2896 filterFade = (barFreq - 100.0f) * 0.005f;
2897 filterFade = LEAF_clip(0.0f, filterFade, 1.0f);
2898 }
2899
2900 x->slideNoise = ((tempSlideNoise1 * dryAmount) + (tempSlideNoise2 * filterAmount * filterFade));// * x->slideAmount;
2901 x->slideNoise *= x->muted;
2902 x->slideNoise = tHighpass_tick(x->barHP, x->slideNoise);
2903 x->slideNoise = tSVF_tick(x->barLP, x->slideNoise * x->slideGain * volCut);
2904 x->slideNoise = x->slideNoise * x->slideGain;
2905 }
2906 else
2907 {
2908 //x->slideNoise = tNoise_tick(&x->pickNoiseSource)*0.3f;
2909 x->slideNoise = x->feedbackNoise;
2910 x->slideNoise *= x->muted;
2911 x->slideNoise = tHighpass_tick(x->barHP, x->slideNoise);
2912 x->slideNoise = tSVF_tick(x->barLP, x->slideNoise * x->slideGain * 0.5f * volCut);
2913 x->slideNoise = x->slideNoise * x->slideGain;
2914 }
2915 for (int i = 0; i < x->oversampling; i++)
2916 {
2917 x->baseDelay = tExpSmooth_tick(x->pitchSmoother);
2918
2919 Lfloat tension = tExpSmooth_tick(x->tensionSmoother) * x->tensionGain * x->baseDelay;
2920
2921
2922 //x->tensionAmount = (tension + (tCycle_tick(&x->tensionModOsc) * tension * 0.0f)) * 0.01f;
2923 x->tensionAmount = tension * 0.01f;
2924 Lfloat currentDelay = x->baseDelay;
2925
2926 //Lfloat currentDelay = x->baseDelay;
2927 if (currentDelay < 5.0f)
2928 {
2929 currentDelay = 5.0f;
2930 }
2931
2932 if (currentDelay > x->maxDelay)
2933 {
2934 currentDelay = x->maxDelay;
2935 }
2936 //tCycle_setFreq(&x->tensionModOsc, (x->sampleRate / (currentDelay - x->tensionAmount)) * 2.0f);
2937 Lfloat halfCurrentDelay = currentDelay * 0.5f;
2938
2939 //tLagrangeDelay_setDelay(&x->delay, x->wavelength-2);//currentDelay - x->tensionAmount - (x->allpassDelay * x->inharmonicMult));// - ((x->phaseComp * INV_TWO_PI ) * currentDelay));
2940 //tLagrangeDelay_setDelay(&x->delayP,x->wavelength-2);// currentDelay - x->tensionAmount - (x->allpassDelayP * x->inharmonicMult));// - ((x->phaseComp * INV_TWO_PI ) * currentDelay));
2941 tLagrangeDelay_setDelay(x->delay, currentDelay - x->tensionAmount - (x->allpassDelay * x->inharmonicMult) - ((x->phaseComp * INV_TWO_PI ) * currentDelay));
2942 tLagrangeDelay_setDelay(x->delayP,currentDelay - x->tensionAmount - (x->allpassDelayP * x->inharmonicMult) - ((x->phaseComp * INV_TWO_PI ) * currentDelay));
2943
2944
2945 Lfloat pickNoiseSound = tNoise_tick(x->pickNoiseSource) * tExpSmooth_tick(x->pickNoise);
2946 tLagrangeDelay_addTo(x->delay,pickNoiseSound * 2.0f, (uint32_t)x->pluckPoint_forInput);
2947 tLagrangeDelay_addTo(x->delayP,pickNoiseSound * 2.0f, (uint32_t)x->pluckPoint_forInput);
2948
2949 Lfloat filterOut = tCookOnePole_tick(x->reflFilt, x->output);
2950 Lfloat filterOutP = tCookOnePole_tick(x->reflFiltP, x->outputP);
2951 //Lfloat filterOut = x->output;
2952 //Lfloat filterOutP = x->outputP;
2953
2954 Lfloat rippleLength = x->rippleRate * currentDelay;
2955 //Lfloat rippleLength = 0.0f;
2956 uint32_t rippleLengthInt = (uint32_t) rippleLength;
2957 Lfloat rippleLengthAlpha = rippleLength - rippleLengthInt;
2958
2959 // Lfloat rippleLength2 = currentDelay - rippleLength;
2960 //uint32_t rippleLengthInt2 = (uint32_t) rippleLength2;
2961 //Lfloat rippleLengthAlpha2 = rippleLength2 - rippleLengthInt2;
2962
2963
2964 //Lfloat rippleOut = (tLagrangeDelay_tapOutInterpolated(&x->delay,rippleLengthInt,rippleLengthAlpha) * x->r);
2965 //delayOut -= (tLagrangeDelay_tapOutInterpolated(&x->delay,rippleLengthInt2,rippleLengthAlpha2) * x->r);
2966 Lfloat delayOut = tLagrangeDelay_tickOut(x->delay);
2967 Lfloat delayOutP = tLagrangeDelay_tickOut(x->delayP);
2968 Lfloat rippleOut1 = (tLagrangeDelay_tapOutInterpolated(x->delay,rippleLengthInt,rippleLengthAlpha) * x->r);
2969 Lfloat rippleOut1P = (tLagrangeDelay_tapOutInterpolated(x->delayP,rippleLengthInt,rippleLengthAlpha) * x->r);
2970
2971
2972 //Lfloat rippleSampleP = (tLagrangeDelay_tapOutInterpolated(&x->delayP,rippleLengthInt,rippleLengthAlpha) * x->r);
2973 //delayOutP += rippleSampleP;
2974 //Lfloat outputP = tLagrangeDelay_tickOut(&x->delayP);
2975
2976 //filterOut = rippleOut1 + rippleOut2;
2977 Lfloat rippleOut = delayOut + rippleOut1;
2978 Lfloat rippleOutP = delayOutP + rippleOut1P;
2979 // outputP += (tLagrangeDelay_tapOutInterpolated(&x->delayP,rippleLengthInt,rippleLengthAlpha) * x->r);
2980
2981
2982 //output += (tLagrangeDelay_tapOutInterpolated(&x->delay,rippleLengthInt2,rippleLengthAlpha2) * x->r);
2983 //output += (tLagrangeDelay_tapOutInterpolated(&x->delayP,rippleLengthInt2,rippleLengthAlpha2) * x->r);
2984 Lfloat allpassOut = rippleOut;
2985 Lfloat allpassOutP = rippleOutP;
2986 if (x->inharmonic)
2987 {
2988 allpassOut = tThiranAllpassSOCascade_tick(x->allpass, rippleOut);
2989 allpassOutP = tThiranAllpassSOCascade_tick(x->allpassP, rippleOutP);
2990 }
2991
2992
2993 x->output = LEAF_clip(-1.0f, (allpassOut * (x->decayCoeff * x->invOnePlusr) * x->muteCoeff), 1.0f);
2994 x->outputP = LEAF_clip(-1.0f, (allpassOutP * (x->decayCoeff * x->invOnePlusr) * x->muteCoeff), 1.0f);
2995
2996
2997 //if past the string ends, need to read backwards and invert
2998 uint32_t backwards = 0;
2999
3000 Lfloat positionMin = (x->openStringLength * 0.104166666666667f);
3001 Lfloat positionMax = (x->openStringLength * 0.021666666666667f);
3002 Lfloat pickupInput = x->pickupPos + (tCycle_tick(x->pickupModOsc) * x->pickupModOscAmp);
3003 //Lfloat pickupInput = x->pickupPos;
3004 Lfloat pickupPos = LEAF_mapFromZeroToOneInput(pickupInput, positionMin, positionMax);
3005
3006 while (pickupPos > halfCurrentDelay)
3007 {
3008 pickupPos = pickupPos - halfCurrentDelay;
3009 backwards = !backwards;
3010 }
3011 while (pickupPos < 0.0f)
3012 {
3013 pickupPos = pickupPos + halfCurrentDelay;
3014 backwards = !backwards;
3015 }
3016 Lfloat pickupPosFinal = pickupPos;
3017 if (backwards)
3018 {
3019 pickupPosFinal = halfCurrentDelay - pickupPos;
3020 }
3021
3022 x->pickup_Ratio = pickupPosFinal / halfCurrentDelay;
3023 uint32_t pickupPosInt = (uint32_t) pickupPosFinal;
3024 uint32_t pickupPosIntPlusOne = pickupPosInt + 1;
3025 Lfloat pickupPosAlpha = pickupPosFinal - pickupPosInt;
3026 Lfloat oneMinusPickupPosAlpha = 1.0f - pickupPosAlpha;
3027 Lfloat inversePickupPos = currentDelay - pickupPos;
3028 if (backwards)
3029 {
3030 inversePickupPos = halfCurrentDelay + pickupPos;
3031 }
3032 uint32_t inversePickupPosInt = (uint32_t) inversePickupPos;
3033 uint32_t inversePickupPosIntPlusOne = inversePickupPosInt + 1;
3034 Lfloat inversePickupPosAlpha = inversePickupPos - inversePickupPosInt;
3035 Lfloat oneMinusinversePickupPosAlpha = 1.0f - inversePickupPosAlpha;
3036
3037 Lfloat rightgoing = tLagrangeDelay_tapOut(x->delay, pickupPosInt) * oneMinusPickupPosAlpha;
3038 rightgoing += tLagrangeDelay_tapOut(x->delay, pickupPosIntPlusOne) * pickupPosAlpha;
3039 Lfloat leftgoing = tLagrangeDelay_tapOut(x->delay, inversePickupPosInt) * oneMinusinversePickupPosAlpha;
3040 leftgoing += tLagrangeDelay_tapOut(x->delay, inversePickupPosIntPlusOne) * inversePickupPosAlpha;
3041
3042 //x->pickupOut = (((volumes[1] * pickupNonLinearity(rightgoing)) + (volumes[0] * rightgoing)) - ((volumes[1] * pickupNonLinearity(leftgoing)) + (volumes[0] * leftgoing)));
3043 x->pickupOut = (pickupNonLinearity(rightgoing) - pickupNonLinearity(leftgoing));
3044 rightgoing = tLagrangeDelay_tapOut(x->delayP, pickupPosInt) * oneMinusPickupPosAlpha;
3045 rightgoing += tLagrangeDelay_tapOut(x->delayP, pickupPosIntPlusOne) * pickupPosAlpha;
3046 leftgoing = tLagrangeDelay_tapOut(x->delayP, inversePickupPosInt) * oneMinusinversePickupPosAlpha;
3047 leftgoing += tLagrangeDelay_tapOut(x->delayP, inversePickupPosIntPlusOne) * inversePickupPosAlpha;
3048
3049 x->pickupOutP = (pickupNonLinearity(rightgoing) - pickupNonLinearity(leftgoing));
3050
3051 Lfloat inputSample = tFeedbackLeveler_tick(x->feedback, tHighpass_tick(x->dcBlock, filterOut + x->slideNoise + x->feedbackNoise * x->feedbackNoiseLevel));
3052 Lfloat inputSampleP = tFeedbackLeveler_tick(x->feedbackP, tHighpass_tick(x->dcBlockP, filterOutP + x->slideNoise + x->feedbackNoise * x->feedbackNoiseLevel));
3053 tLagrangeDelay_tickIn(x->delay, inputSample);
3054 tLagrangeDelay_tickIn(x->delayP, inputSampleP);
3055 //tLagrangeDelay_tickIn(&x->delayP, delayOutP + x->slideNoise);
3056 //Lfloat outputPfilt = 0.0f;
3057 Lfloat outputPfilt = tSVF_tick(x->lowpassP, x->pickupOutP);
3058 outputPfilt = tSVF_tick(x->highpassP, outputPfilt);
3059 Lfloat volumes[2];
3060 LEAF_crossfade(x->pickupAmount * 2.0f - 1.0f,volumes);
3061 Lfloat prefilter = (x->pickupOut + (outputPfilt * x->phantomGain)) * 2.0f;
3062 Lfloat prefilter2 = tSVF_tick(x->pickupFilter2, prefilter);// + x->slideNoise;
3063 Lfloat prefilter3 = tSVF_tick(x->pickupFilter, prefilter2);// + x->slideNoise;
3064 Lfloat prefilter4 = tSVF_tick(x->peakFilt, prefilter3);// + x->slideNoise;
3065
3066 theOutput = (prefilter4 * 1.3f* volumes[1]) + (prefilter * 1.3f * volumes[0]);
3067 }
3068 return theOutput;
3069}

3071void tTString_setFreq (tTString const x, Lfloat freq)
3072{
3073 if (freq < x->actualLowestFreq)
3074 freq = x->actualLowestFreq;
3075 //freq = freq * x->invOversampling;
3076 x->freq = freq;
3077
3078 Lfloat Fc = (freq*x->invSampleRateTimesTwoPi);
3079
3080 //tExpSmooth_setDest(&x->pitchSmoother, (x->sampleRate / freq) - 1.0f);
3081 tExpSmooth_setDest(x->pitchSmoother, (x->sampleRate / freq) - 2.0f); //why 2? is it the combo of the lowpass one pole and highpass one pole?

3084#ifdef ARM_MATH_CM7
3085 Lfloat result = 0.0f;
3086 arm_atan2_f32(x->poleCoeff * arm_sin_f32(Fc) , 1.0f - (x->poleCoeff * arm_cos_f32(Fc)), &result);

3091#endif

3274void tTString_pluck (tTString const x, Lfloat position, Lfloat amplitude)
3275{
3276 x->muted = 1.0f;
3277 tExpSmooth_setVal(x->tensionSmoother, amplitude);
3278 tFeedbackLeveler_setTargetLevel(x->feedback, amplitude * 0.25f);
3279 tFeedbackLeveler_setTargetLevel(x->feedbackP, amplitude * 0.25f);
3280 tExpSmooth_setValAndDest(x->pitchSmoother, x->pitchSmoother->dest);
3281 x->baseDelay = x->pitchSmoother->dest;
3282 Lfloat currentDelay = x->baseDelay;// - x->allpassDelay;
3283 x->muteCoeff = 1.0f;
3284 uint32_t halfCurrentDelay = currentDelay * 0.5f;
3285 uint32_t currentDelayInt = halfCurrentDelay * 2.0f;
3286 Lfloat positionMin = (x->openStringLength * 0.204166666666667f);
3287 Lfloat positionMax = (x->openStringLength * 0.001f);
3288
3289 volatile Lfloat pluckPoint = LEAF_mapFromZeroToOneInput(position, positionMin, positionMax);
3290 //0.083335f; * position;//position * halfCurrentDelay;
3291 pluckPoint = LEAF_clip(0.0f, pluckPoint, halfCurrentDelay);
3292 uint32_t pluckPointInt = (uint32_t) pluckPoint;
3293 Lfloat invPluckPointInt = (1.0f / ((Lfloat)pluckPointInt+.001f));
3294 volatile Lfloat invRemainder = 1.0f / ((halfCurrentDelay-pluckPoint)+.001f);
3295 tLagrangeDelay_clear(x->delay);
3296 x->pluckRatio = pluckPoint / halfCurrentDelay;
3297 x->pluckPoint_forInput = pluckPoint;
3298 for (uint32_t i = 0; i < halfCurrentDelay; i++)
3299 {
3300 Lfloat val = 0.0f;
3301 //displacement waves
3302 if (i == pluckPointInt)
3303 {
3304 val = 1.0f;
3305 }
3306 else if (i < pluckPointInt)
3307 {
3308 val = ((Lfloat)i * invPluckPointInt);
3309 }
3310 else
3311 {
3312 val = (1.0f - (((Lfloat)i-(Lfloat)pluckPointInt)*invRemainder));
3313 }
3314 val = LEAF_tanh(val* 1.2f) * amplitude;
3315 tLagrangeDelay_tapIn(x->delay, val, i);
3316 tLagrangeDelay_tapIn(x->delay, -val, currentDelayInt-i);
3317 tLagrangeDelay_tapIn(x->delayP, val, i);
3318 tLagrangeDelay_tapIn(x->delayP, -val, currentDelayInt-i);
3319
3320 }
3321 tThiranAllpassSOCascade_clear(x->allpass);
3322 tThiranAllpassSOCascade_clear(x->allpassP);
3323
3324 tExpSmooth_setVal(x->pickNoise, amplitude);
3325}
