3399void tBowTable_initToPool (tBowTable* const bt, tMempool* const mp)
3400{
3401 _tMempool* m = *mp;
3402 _tBowTable* x = *bt = (_tBowTable*) mpool_alloc(sizeof(_tBowTable), m);
3403 x->mempool = m;
3404
3405 x->offSet = 0.0f;
3406 x->slope = 0.1f;
3407 x->lastOutput = 0.0f;
3408}
3409void tBowTable_free (tBowTable* const bt)
3410{
3411 _tBowTable* x = *bt;
3412 mpool_free((char*)x, x->mempool);
3413
3414}
3415Lfloat tBowTable_lookup (tBowTable const x, Lfloat sample)
3416{
3417 Lfloat input;
3418 input = sample + x->offSet; /* add bias to sample */
3419 input *= x->slope; /* scale it */
3420 x->lastOutput = (float)fabs((double) input) + 0.75f; /* below min delta, friction = 1 */
3421 x->lastOutput = pow(x->lastOutput, -4.0f);
3422 if (x->lastOutput > 1.0f ) x->lastOutput = 1.0f; /* maximum friction is 1.0 */
3423 return x->lastOutput;
3424}

3451Lfloat tReedTable_tick (tReedTable const p, Lfloat input)
3452{
3453 // The input is differential pressure across the reed.
3454 Lfloat output = p->offset + (p->slope * input);
3455
3456 // If output is > 1, the reed has slammed shut and the
3457 // reflection function value saturates at 1.0.
3458 if ( output > 1.0f) output = 1.0f;
3459
3460 // This is nearly impossible in a physical system, but
3461 // a reflection function value of -1.0 corresponds to
3462 // an open end (and no discontinuity in bore profile).
3463 if ( output < -1.0f) output = -1.0f;
3464
3465 return output;
3466}
3467
3468Lfloat tReedTable_tanh_tick (tReedTable const p, Lfloat input)
3469{
3470 // The input is differential pressure across the reed.
3471 Lfloat output = p->offset + (p->slope * input);
3472
3473 // If output is > 1, the reed has slammed shut and the
3474 // reflection function value saturates at 1.0.
3475 return tanhf(output);
3476}

3495void tStiffString_initToPool (tStiffString* const pm, int numModes, tMempool* const mp)

3500
3501 // initialize variables
3502 p->numModes = numModes;
3503 p->freqHz = 440.0f;
3504 p->stiffness = 0.001f;
3505 p->pluckPos = 0.2f;
3506 p->pickupPos = 0.3f;
3507 p->decay = 0.0001f;
3508 p->decayHighFreq = 0.0003f;
3509 p->muteDecay = 0.4f;
3510 p->sampleRate = m->leaf->sampleRate;
3511 p->twoPiTimesInvSampleRate = m->leaf->twoPiTimesInvSampleRate;
3512 p->nyquist = p->sampleRate * 0.5f;
3513 Lfloat lessThanNyquist = p->sampleRate * 0.4f;
3514 p->nyquistScalingFactor = 1.0f / (lessThanNyquist - p->nyquist);
3515 p->amp = 0.0f;
3516 p->gainComp = 0.0f;
3517
3518 // allocate memory
3519 /*
3520 p->osc = (tDampedOscillator *) mpool_alloc(numModes * sizeof(tDampedOscillator), m);
3521 for (int i = 0; i < numModes; ++i) {
3522 tDampedOscillator_initToPool(&p->osc[i], &m);
3523 }
3524 */
3525 p->osc = (tCycle *) mpool_alloc(numModes * sizeof(tCycle), m);
3526 for (int i = 0; i < numModes; ++i) {
3527 tCycle_initToPool(&p->osc[i], &m);
3528 }
3529 //
3530 p->amplitudes = (Lfloat *) mpool_alloc(numModes * sizeof(Lfloat), m);
3531 p->outputWeights = (Lfloat *) mpool_alloc(numModes * sizeof(Lfloat), m);
3532 p->decayScalar = (Lfloat *) mpool_alloc(numModes * sizeof(Lfloat), m);
3533 p->decayVal = (Lfloat *) mpool_alloc(numModes * sizeof(Lfloat), m);

3556
3557void tStiffString_updateOscillators(tStiffString const p)
3558{
3559 Lfloat kappa_sq = p->stiffness * p->stiffness;
3560 Lfloat compensation = 0.0f;
3561 for (int i = 0; i < p->numModes; ++i) {
3562 int n = i + 1;
3563 int n_sq = n * n;
3564 Lfloat sig = p->decay + p->decayHighFreq * n_sq;
3565 //Lfloat w0 = n * sqrtf(1.0f + kappa_sq * n_sq);
3566 Lfloat w0 = n * (1.0f + 0.5f * kappa_sq * n_sq);
3567 Lfloat zeta = sig / w0;
3568 //Lfloat w = w0 * sqrtf(1.0f - zeta * zeta);
3569 Lfloat w = w0 * (1.0f - 0.5f * zeta * zeta);
3570 if (i == 0)
3571 {
3572 compensation = 1.0f / w;
3573 }
3574 /*
3575 if ((p->freqHz * w) < (p->sampleRate * 0.4f))
3576 {
3577 tDampedOscillator_setFreq(&p->osc[i], p->freqHz * w * compensation);
3578 tDampedOscillator_setDecay(&p->osc[i],p->freqHz * sig);
3579 }
3580 else
3581 {
3582 tDampedOscillator_setDecay(&p->osc[i],0.5f);
3583 }
3584 */
3585 Lfloat testFreq = (p->freqHz * w);
3586 Lfloat nyquistTest = (testFreq - p->nyquist) * p->nyquistScalingFactor;
3587 p->nyquistCoeff[i] = LEAF_clip(0.0f, nyquistTest, 1.0f);
3588 tCycle_setFreq(p->osc[i], testFreq * compensation);
3589 //tDampedOscillator_setDecay(&p->osc[i],p->freqHz * sig);
3590 Lfloat val = p->freqHz * sig;
3591 Lfloat r = fastExp4(-val * p->twoPiTimesInvSampleRate);
3592 p->decayScalar[i] = r * r;
3593 }
3594}
3595void tStiffString_updateOutputWeights(tStiffString const p)
3596{
3597 Lfloat x0 = p->pickupPos * PI;
3598 Lfloat totalGain = 0.0f;
3599 for (int i = 0; i < p->numModes; ++i)
3600 {
3601#ifdef ARM_MATH_CM7
3602 p->outputWeights[i] = arm_sin_f32((i + 1) * x0);
3603 totalGain += fabsf(p->outputWeights[i]) * p->amplitudes[i];;
3604
3605#else
3606 p->outputWeights[i] = sinf((i + 1) * x0);
3607 totalGain += p->outputWeights[i] * p->amplitudes[i];
3608#endif
3609 }
3610 if (totalGain < 0.01f)
3611 {
3612 totalGain = 0.01f;
3613 }
3614 totalGain = LEAF_clip(0.01f, totalGain, 1.0f);
3615 p->gainComp = 1.0f / totalGain;
3616}
3617
3618Lfloat tStiffString_tick (tStiffString const p)
3619{
3620 Lfloat sample = 0.0f;
3621 for (int i = 0; i < p->numModes; ++i) {
3622 //sample += tDampedOscillator_tick(&p->osc[i]) * p->amplitudes[i] * p->outputWeights[i];
3623 sample += tCycle_tick(p->osc[i]) * p->amplitudes[i] * p->outputWeights[i] * p->decayVal[i] * p->nyquistCoeff[i];
3624 p->decayVal[i] *= p->decayScalar[i] * p->muteDecay;
3625 }
3626 return sample * p->amp * p->gainComp;
3627}

3763void tStereoRotation_initToPool (tStereoRotation* const rr, tMempool* const mp)

3770

3776 tHighpass_initToPool(&r->hip2, 10.0f, mp);
3777 tOnePole_initToPool(&r->filtx, 8000.0f, mp);
3778 tOnePole_initToPool(&r->filty, 8000.0f, mp);
3779 r->rotGain = 0.9999f;
3780 tLagrangeDelay_initToPool(&r->rotDelayx, 100.0f, 2000, mp);
3781 tLagrangeDelay_initToPool(&r->rotDelayy, 100.0f, 2000, mp);

3783 r->feedbackFactory = 0.9995f;

3787void tStereoRotation_tick (tStereoRotation const r, float* samples)
3788{
3789
3790
3791 float samplex = (samples[0] + r->vcaoutx);
3792 float sampley = (samples[1] + r->vcaouty);
3793
3794 samplex = tHighpass_tick(r->hip1, samplex * r->rotGain);
3795 sampley = tHighpass_tick(r->hip2, sampley * r->rotGain);
3796 // float samplex = (input[0] + vcaoutx);
3797 // float sampley = (input[1] + vcaouty);
3798
3799 float rotOutx = (samplex * cosf(r->angle)) - (sampley * sinf(r->angle));
3800 float rotOuty = (samplex * sinf(r->angle)) + (sampley * cosf(r->angle));
3801
3802 float delayoutx = tLagrangeDelay_tick(r->rotDelayx, tanhf(rotOutx));
3803 float delayouty = tLagrangeDelay_tick(r->rotDelayy,tanhf( rotOuty));
3804
3805
3806 float filteroutx = tOnePole_tick(r->filtx, delayoutx);
3807 float filterouty = tOnePole_tick(r->filty, delayouty);
3808 r->vcaoutx = filteroutx * r->feedbackFactorx;
3809 r->vcaouty = filterouty * r->feedbackFactory;
3810
3811 samples[0] = filteroutx;
3812 samples[1] = filterouty;
3813 return;
3814}
